1.m: Feeding on air, fasting, feeding on water, and eating leaves, / he thus passed that time, meditating on her who comprises the universe.

1.s:
gate dakṣe tapaḥ kartuṃ brahmā sarvajagatpatiḥ |
jagāma mandarābhyāsaṃ puṇyātpuṇyataraṃ varam || 13 ||
1.d:
गते दक्षे तपः कर्तुं ब्रह्मा सर्वजगत्पतिः ।
जगाम मन्दराभ्यासं पुण्यात्पुण्यतरं वरम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.m: When Dakṣa had gone to perform austerities, Brahmā, the lord of all the worlds, / went near Mandara, an excellent place, holy beyond the holy.

1.s:
tatra gatvā jagaddhātrīṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ jaganmayīm |
tuṣṭāva vāgbhirarthyābhirekatānaṃ śataṃ samāḥ || 14 ||
1.d:
तत्र गत्वा जगद्धात्रीं विष्णुमायां जगन्मयीम् ।
तुष्टाव वाग्भिरर्थ्याभिरेकतानं शतं समाः ॥ 14 ॥
1.m: Going there, he praised Viṣṇumāyā, the bearer of the universe, who comprises the world, / with earnest words, single-minded for a hundred years.

1.s: brahmovāca
1.d: ब्रह्मोवाच

1.s:
vidyāvidyātmikāṃ śuddhāṃ nirālambāṃ nirākulām |
staumi devīṃ jagaddhātrīṃ sthūlāṇīyaḥ svarūpiṇīm || 15 ||
1.d:
विद्याविद्यात्मिकां शुद्धां निरालम्बां निराकुलाम् ।
स्तौमि देवीं जगद्धात्रीं स्थूलाणीयः स्वरूपिणीम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.m: "I praise the goddess, the bearer of the universe, who consists of knowledge and ignorance, pure, / independent, untroubled, whose nature is both gross and minute;

1.s:
yasyā udeti ca jagatpradhānākhyaṃ jagatparam |
yasyāstadaṃśabhūtāṃ tvāṃ staumi nidrāṃ sanātanīm || 16 ||
1.d:
यस्या उदेति च जगत्प्रधानाख्यं जगत्परम् ।
यस्यास्तदंशभूतां त्वां स्तौमि निद्रां सनातनीम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.m: from whom arises the universe called pradhāna, transcending the world, / and whose portion you are: I praise you, the eternal Nidrā.

1.s:
tvaṃ citiḥ paramānandā paramātmasvarūpiṇī |
śaktistvaṃ sarvabhūtānā tva sarveṣāṃ ca pāvanī || 17 ||
1.d:
त्वं चितिः परमानन्दा परमात्मस्वरूपिणी ।
शक्तिस्त्वं सर्वभूताना त्व सर्वेषां च पावनी ॥ 17 ॥
1.m: You are consciousness, supreme bliss, possessing the nature of the Supreme Self; / you are the power of all beings, and the purifier of all.

1.s:
tvaṃ sāvitrī jagaddhātrī tva sandhyā tva ratirdhṛtiḥ |
tvaṃ hi jyoti svarūpeṇa sasārasya prakāśinī || 18 ||
1.d:
त्वं सावित्री जगद्धात्री त्व सन्ध्या त्व रतिर्धृतिः ।
त्वं हि ज्योति स्वरूपेण ससारस्य प्रकाशिनी ॥ 18 ॥
1.m: You are Sāvitrī, the bearer of the universe; you are Sandhyā, you are pleasure and steadfastness; / for you, in the form of light, illuminate the world.

1.s:
tathā tamaḥsvarūpeṇa cchādayantī sadā jagat |
tvameva sṛṣṭirūpeṇa sasāraparipūraṇī || 19 ||
1.d:
तथा तमःस्वरूपेण च्छादयन्ती सदा जगत् ।
त्वमेव सृष्टिरूपेण ससारपरिपूरणी ॥ 19 ॥
1.m: Likewise, in the form of darkness, you constantly veil the world; / you alone, in the form of creation, fully replenish the cycle of existence.

1.s:
sthitirūpeṇa ca harerjagatāṃ ca hiteṣiṇī |
tathaivāntasvarūpeṇa jagatāmantakāriṇī || 20 ||
1.d:
स्थितिरूपेण च हरेर्जगतां च हितेषिणी ।
तथैवान्तस्वरूपेण जगतामन्तकारिणी ॥ 20 ॥
1.m: And in the form of maintenance, you wish the welfare of the worlds of Hari; / likewise, in the form of the end, you bring an end to the worlds.

1.s:
tvaṃ medhā tvaṃ mahāmāyā tvaṃ svadhā pitṛmodinī |
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ namaskāravaṣaṭkārau tathā smṛtiḥ || 21 ||
1.d:
त्वं मेधा त्वं महामाया त्वं स्वधा पितृमोदिनी ।
त्वं स्वाहा त्वं नमस्कारवषट्कारौ तथा स्मृतिः ॥ 21 ॥
1.m: You are wisdom, you are Mahāmāyā, you are svadhā that gladdens the ancestors; / you are svāhā, you are the utterance of namas and vaṣaṭ, and likewise memory.

1.s:
tvaṃ puṣṭistvaṃ dhṛtirmaitrī karuṇā muditā tathā |
tvameva lajjā tvaṃ śāntistvaṃ kāntirjagadīśvarī || 22 ||
1.d:
त्वं पुष्टिस्त्वं धृतिर्मैत्री करुणा मुदिता तथा ।
त्वमेव लज्जा त्वं शान्तिस्त्वं कान्तिर्जगदीश्वरी ॥ 22 ॥
1.m: You are nourishment, you are fortitude, friendliness, compassion, and sympathetic joy; / you alone are modesty, you are tranquility, you are beauty, the sovereign of the world;

1.s:
mahāmāyā tvaṃ ca svāhā svadhā ca pitṛdevatā |
yā sṛṣṭiśaktirasmākaṃ sthitiśaktiśca yā hareḥ || 23 ||
1.d:
महामाया त्वं च स्वाहा स्वधा च पितृदेवता ।
या सृष्टिशक्तिरस्माकं स्थितिशक्तिश्च या हरेः ॥ 23 ॥
1.m: you are Mahāmāyā, svāhā, and svadhā, the deity of the ancestors; / that power of creation which is ours, and that power of maintenance which belongs to Hari,

1.s: antaśaktistatheśānī sā tvaṃ śaktiḥ sanātani || 24 ||
1.d: अन्तशक्तिस्तथेशानी सा त्वं शक्तिः सनातनि ॥ 24 ॥
1.m: and likewise the power of dissolution, Īśānī—that power are you, O eternal one!

1.s:
ekā tvaṃ dvividhā bhūtvā mokṣasaṃsārakāriṇī |
vidyāvidyāsvarūpeṇa svaprakāśāprakāśataḥ || 25 ||
1.d:
एका त्वं द्विविधा भूत्वा मोक्षसंसारकारिणी ।
विद्याविद्यास्वरूपेण स्वप्रकाशाप्रकाशतः ॥ 25 ॥
1.m: Being one, you become twofold, bringing about liberation and worldly existence / by taking the forms of knowledge and ignorance, through self-illumination and non-illumination.

1.s:
tvaṃ lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ chāyā tvaṃ sarasvatī |
trayīmayī trimātrā tvaṃ sarvabhūtasvarūpiṇī || 26 ||
1.d:
त्वं लक्ष्मीः सर्वभूतानां त्वं छाया त्वं सरस्वती ।
त्रयीमयी त्रिमात्रा त्वं सर्वभूतस्वरूपिणी ॥ 26 ॥
1.m: You are the fortune of all beings, you are shadow, you are Sarasvatī; / you embody the three Vedas, possessing the three morae, having the form of all beings.

1.s:
udgītiḥ sāmavedasya yā pitṛgaṇarañjanī |
tvaṃ vediḥ sarvayajñānāṃ sāmidhenī tathā haviḥ || 27 ||
1.d:
उद्गीतिः सामवेदस्य या पितृगणरञ्जनी ।
त्वं वेदिः सर्वयज्ञानां सामिधेनी तथा हविः ॥ 27 ॥
1.m: You are the Udgītha of the Sāmaveda, which delights the host of ancestors; / you are the altar of all sacrifices, the sāmidhenī verses, and the offering.

1.s:
yadavyaktamanirdeśyaṃ niṣkalaṃ paramātmanaḥ |
rūpaṃ tathaiva tanmātraṃ sakalaṃ ca jaganmayam || 28 ||
1.d:
यदव्यक्तमनिर्देश्यं निष्कलं परमात्मनः ।
रूपं तथैव तन्मात्रं सकलं च जगन्मयम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.m: Whatever unmanifest, indescribable, partless / form of the Supreme Self there is, and likewise subtle elements and that which is with parts, comprising the universe—

1.s:
yā mūrttirvi ratā sarvadharitro bibhratī kṣitim |
sā tvaṃ viśvambhare loke śaktibhūtipradā sadā || 29 ||
1.d:
या मूर्त्तिर्वि रता सर्वधरित्रो बिभ्रती क्षितिम् ।
सा त्वं विश्वम्भरे लोके शक्तिभूतिप्रदा सदा ॥ 29 ॥
1.m: that form which is spread out, bearing the earth as all-supporter, / that are you, all-bearing in the world, ever granting power and prosperity.

1.s:
tvaṃ takṣmīścetanā kāntistvaṃ puṣṭistvaṃ sanātanī |
tvaṃ kālarātristvaṃ muktiḥ śāntiḥ prajñā tathā smṛtiḥ || 30 ||
1.d:
त्वं तक्ष्मीश्चेतना कान्तिस्त्वं पुष्टिस्त्वं सनातनी ।
त्वं कालरात्रिस्त्वं मुक्तिः शान्तिः प्रज्ञा तथा स्मृतिः ॥ 30 ॥
1.m: You are Lakṣmī, consciousness, beauty, you are nourishment, you are eternal; / you are Kālarātri, you are liberation, tranquility, wisdom, and recollection.

1.s:
saṃsārasāgarottārataraṇi sukhamokṣade |
prasīda sarvajagatāṃ tvaṃ gatistvaṃ matiḥ sadā || 31 ||
1.d:
संसारसागरोत्तारतरणि सुखमोक्षदे ।
प्रसीद सर्वजगतां त्वं गतिस्त्वं मतिः सदा ॥ 31 ॥
1.m: O boat for crossing the ocean of existence, bestower of happiness and liberation! / Be gracious: you are the refuge, you are the intellect of all worlds forever.

1.s:
tvaṃ nityā tvamanityā ca tvaṃ carācaramohinī |
tvaṃ sandhinī sarvayogasāṅgopāṅgavibhāvinī || 32 ||
1.d:
त्वं नित्या त्वमनित्या च त्वं चराचरमोहिनी ।
त्वं सन्धिनी सर्वयोगसाङ्गोपाङ्गविभाविनी ॥ 32 ॥
1.m: You are eternal and you are non-eternal; you enchant moving and unmoving beings; / you are the unifier, manifesting all yoga with its limbs and sub-limbs.

1.s:
cintā kīrtiryatīnāṃ tvaṃ tvaṃ tadaṣṭāṅgasaṃyutā |
tvaṃ khaḍginī śūlinī ca cakriṇī ghorarūpiṇī || 33 ||
1.d:
चिन्ता कीर्तिर्यतीनां त्वं त्वं तदष्टाङ्गसंयुता ।
त्वं खड्गिनी शूलिनी च चक्रिणी घोररूपिणी ॥ 33 ॥
1.m: You are the contemplation and the renown of ascetics; you are endowed with its eight limbs; / you bear the sword and the trident, you hold the discus, having a terrible form.

1.s:
tvamīśvarī janānāṃ tvaṃ sarvānugrahakāriṇī |
viśvādistvamanādistvaṃ viśvayonirayonijā |
anantā sarvajagatastvamevaikāntakāriṇī || 34 ||
1.d:
त्वमीश्वरी जनानां त्वं सर्वानुग्रहकारिणी ।
विश्वादिस्त्वमनादिस्त्वं विश्वयोनिरयोनिजा ।
अनन्ता सर्वजगतस्त्वमेवैकान्तकारिणी ॥ 34 ॥
1.m: You are the sovereign of people, you bestow grace upon all; / you are the beginning of the universe, you are without beginning; you are the source of all, unborn from a womb; / boundless, you alone bring about the end of the entire universe.

1.s:
nitāntanirmalā tvaṃ hi tāmasīti ca gīyase |
taṃ hiṃsā tvamahiṃsā ca tvaṃ kālī caturānanā || 35 ||
1.d:
नितान्तनिर्मला त्वं हि तामसीति च गीयसे ।
तं हिंसा त्वमहिंसा च त्वं काली चतुरानना ॥ 35 ॥
1.m: Though exceedingly spotless, you are indeed sung of as dark; / you are injury and non-injury; you are Kālī, the four-faced goddess.

1.s:
tvaṃ parā sarvajananī damanī dāminī tathā |
tvayyeva līyate viśvaṃ bhāti tattvaṃ tadbibhartti ca || 36 ||
1.d:
त्वं परा सर्वजननी दमनी दामिनी तथा ।
त्वय्येव लीयते विश्वं भाति तत्त्वं तद्बिभर्त्ति च ॥ 36 ॥
1.m: You are the supreme, mother of all, the subduer, and the self-controlled; / into you alone dissolves the universe, that truth shines, and you uphold it.

1.s:
tvaṃ sṛṣṭihīnā tvaṃ sṛṣṭistvamakarṇāpi saśrutiḥ |
tapasvinī pāṇipādahīnā tvaṃ nitarāṃ grahā || 37 ||
1.d:
त्वं सृष्टिहीना त्वं सृष्टिस्त्वमकर्णापि सश्रुतिः ।
तपस्विनी पाणिपादहीना त्वं नितरां ग्रहा ॥ 37 ॥
1.m: You are devoid of creation, yet you are creation; though without ears, you have hearing; / you are ascetic; though without hands and feet, you grasp completely.

1.s:
tvaṃ dvaustvamāpastvaṃ jyotirvāyustvaṃ ca nabho manaḥ |
ahaṃkāro'pi jagatāmaṣṭadhā prakṛtiḥ kṛtiḥ || 38 ||
1.d:
त्वं द्वौस्त्वमापस्त्वं ज्योतिर्वायुस्त्वं च नभो मनः ।
अहंकारोऽपि जगतामष्टधा प्रकृतिः कृतिः ॥ 38 ॥
1.m: You are the sky, you are water, you are light, wind, space, and mind; / you are the egoism of the worlds, the eightfold nature and action.

1.s:
jagannābhirmerurūpadhāriṇī nālikāparā |
parāparātmikā śuddhā māyā mohātikāriṇī || 39 ||
1.d:
जगन्नाभिर्मेरुरूपधारिणी नालिकापरा ।
परापरात्मिका शुद्धा माया मोहातिकारिणी ॥ 39 ॥
1.m: You are the navel of the world, bearing the form of Meru, supreme stalk of the lotus; / having the nature of higher and lower, pure Māyā producing delusion.

1.s:
kāraṇaṃ kāryabhūtañca satyaṃ śāntaṃ śivāśive |
rūpāṇi tava viśvārthe rāgavṛkṣaphalāni ca || 40 ||
1.d:
कारणं कार्यभूतञ्च सत्यं शान्तं शिवाशिवे ।
रूपाणि तव विश्वार्थे रागवृक्षफलानि च ॥ 40 ॥
1.m: The cause and the effect, truth, peacefulness, auspicious and inauspicious— / these forms are yours for the sake of the universe, as are the fruits of the tree of passion.

1.s:
nitāntahrasvā dīrghā ca nitāntāṇubṛhattanuḥ |
sūkṣmāpyakhilalokasya vyāpinī tvaṃ jaganmayī || 41 ||
1.d:
नितान्तह्रस्वा दीर्घा च नितान्ताणुबृहत्तनुः ।
सूक्ष्माप्यखिललोकस्य व्यापिनी त्वं जगन्मयी ॥ 41 ॥
1.m: Extremely short and long, with an exceedingly tiny or massive body; / though subtle, you pervade the entire world, comprising the universe.

1.s:
mānahīnā vimānātivimānonmānasambhavā |
yadaṣṭivyaṣṭisambhogarāgādigalitāśayā |
tatte mahimni tadrūpaṃ tava bhrāntyādikaṃ ca yat || 42 ||
1.d:
मानहीना विमानातिविमानोन्मानसम्भवा ।
यदष्टिव्यष्टिसम्भोगरागादिगलिताशया ।
तत्ते महिम्नि तद्रूपं तव भ्रान्त्यादिकं च यत् ॥ 42 ॥
1.m: Devoid of measure, born of immeasurable, extensive, and standard measures; / whose heart is freed from desire and the like through the enjoyment of the totality and parts— / that is your form in majesty, and whatever delusion or the like belongs to you.

1.s:
iṣṭāniṣṭavipākajñā yatheṣṭāniṣṭakāraṇam |
sargādimadhyāntamayaṃ nimnaṃ rūpaṃ tathaiva ca || 43 ||
1.d:
इष्टानिष्टविपाकज्ञा यथेष्टानिष्टकारणम् ।
सर्गादिमध्यान्तमयं निम्नं रूपं तथैव च ॥ 43 ॥
1.m: Knowing the maturation of desired and undesired deeds, you are the cause of what is desired and undesired; / you consist of the beginning, middle, and end of creation, and your form is also lowly.

1.s:
vicārāṣṭāṅgayogena sampādyaivaṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
yat sthirīkriyate tattvaṃ tatte rūpaṃ sanātanam || 44 ||
1.d:
विचाराष्टाङ्गयोगेन सम्पाद्यैवं मुहुर्मुहुः ।
यत् स्थिरीक्रियते तत्त्वं तत्ते रूपं सनातनम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.m: That principle which is repeatedly stabilized / having accomplished it through discernment and the eight-limbed yoga, that is your eternal form.

1.s:
bāhyābāhye sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jñānājñāne layālayau |
upatāpastathā śāntirbhūtistvaṃ jagataḥ pateḥ || 45 ||
1.d:
बाह्याबाह्ये सुखं दुःखं ज्ञानाज्ञाने लयालयौ ।
उपतापस्तथा शान्तिर्भूतिस्त्वं जगतः पतेः ॥ 45 ॥
1.m: Outer and non-outer, pleasure, pain, knowledge and ignorance, dissolution and non-dissolution, / affliction and peace: you are the prosperity of the Lord of the universe."

1.s:
yasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ no vaktuṃ śaknoti bhuvanatraye |
tayaiva sanmohakarī sā tvaṃ kiṃ stūyase mayā || 46 ||
1.d:
यस्याः प्रभावं नो वक्तुं शक्नोति भुवनत्रये ।
तयैव सन्मोहकरी सा त्वं किं स्तूयसे मया ॥ 46 ॥
1.m: Whose power no one in the three worlds is able to tell, / who causes total delusion by that very [power], how can you be praised by me?

1.s:
yoganidrā mahānidrā mohanidrā jaganmayī |
viṣṇumāyā ca prakṛtiḥ kastvāṃ stutyā vibhāvayet || 47 ||
1.d:
योगनिद्रा महानिद्रा मोहनिद्रा जगन्मयी ।
विष्णुमाया च प्रकृतिः कस्त्वां स्तुत्या विभावयेत् ॥ 47 ॥
1.m: Yoganidrā, Mahānidrā, Mohanidrā, consisting of the universe, / Viṣṇumāyā and Prakṛti—who could comprehend you through praise?

1.s:
mama viṣṇoḥ śaṃkarasya yā vapurvahanātmikā |
tasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ ko vaktuṃ guṇān vettuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ || 48 ||
1.d:
मम विष्णोः शंकरस्य या वपुर्वहनात्मिका ।
तस्याः प्रभावं को वक्तुं गुणान् वेत्तुं च कः क्षमः ॥ 48 ॥
1.m: Of her whose nature is bearing the bodies of me, Viṣṇu, and Śaṃkara, / who is capable of speaking the power or knowing the qualities?

1.s:
prakāśakaraṇajyotiḥsvarūpāntaragocarā |
tvameva jaṅgamastheyarūpaikā bāhyagocarā || 49 ||
1.d:
प्रकाशकरणज्योतिःस्वरूपान्तरगोचरा ।
त्वमेव जङ्गमस्थेयरूपैका बाह्यगोचरा ॥ 49 ॥
1.m: Within whose inner sphere is the light-nature that causes illumination, / you alone, as the sole form of moving and stationary beings, are the external sphere.

1.s:
prasīda sarvajagatāṃ jananī strīsvarūpiṇī |
viśvarūpiṇī viśveśe prasīda tvaṃ sanātani || 50 ||
1.d:
प्रसीद सर्वजगतां जननी स्त्रीस्वरूपिणी ।
विश्वरूपिणी विश्वेशे प्रसीद त्वं सनातनि ॥ 50 ॥
1.m: Be gracious, mother of all worlds, whose form is woman, / whose form is the universe, sovereign of the universe! Be gracious, eternal one!

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
evaṃ saṃstūyamānā sā yoganidrā viriñcinā |
āvirbabhūva pratyakṣaṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ || 51 ||
1.d:
एवं संस्तूयमाना सा योगनिद्रा विरिञ्चिना ।
आविर्बभूव प्रत्यक्षं ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः ॥ 51 ॥
1.m: Thus being praised by Viriñci, that Yoganidrā / appeared visibly before Brahmā, the Supreme Self.

1.s:
snigdhāñjanadyutiścārurūpāttuṅgā caturbhujā |
siṃhasthā khaḍganīlābjahastā muktakacotkarā || 52 ||
1.d:
स्निग्धाञ्जनद्युतिश्चारुरूपात्तुङ्गा चतुर्भुजा ।
सिंहस्था खड्गनीलाब्जहस्ता मुक्तकचोत्करा ॥ 52 ॥
1.m: Radiant like glossy collyrium, beautiful in form, exalted, four-armed, / mounted on a lion, holding a sword and a blue lotus in her hands, with her mass of hair unbound.

1.s:
samakṣamatha tāṃ vīkṣya sraṣṭā sarvajagadguruḥ |
bhaktyā vinamratuṅgāṃsastuṣṭāva ca nanāma ca || 53 ||
1.d:
समक्षमथ तां वीक्ष्य स्रष्टा सर्वजगद्गुरुः ।
भक्त्या विनम्रतुङ्गांसस्तुष्टाव च ननाम च ॥ 53 ॥
1.m: Seeing her before him, the creator, the guru of all the world, / his high shoulders bowed with devotion, praised and bowed down to her.

1.s: brahmovāca
1.d: ब्रह्मोवाच

1.s:
namo namaste jagataḥ pravṛttinivṛttirūpe sthitisargarūpe |
carācarāṇāṃ bhavatī ca śaktiḥ sanātanī sarvavimohanīti || 54 ||
1.d:
नमो नमस्ते जगतः प्रवृत्तिनिवृत्तिरूपे स्थितिसर्गरूपे ।
चराचराणां भवती च शक्तिः सनातनी सर्वविमोहनीति ॥ 54 ॥
1.m: Homage, homage to you whose form is the world's activity and cessation, whose form is maintenance and creation! / You are the eternal Śakti of moving and unmoving beings, deluding all!

1.s:
yaḥ śrīḥ sadā keśavamūrtimāyā viśvambharā yā sakalaṃ bibharti |
hrīryoginī yā mahitā manojñā sā tvaṃ namaste paramātmasāre || 55 ||
1.d:
यः श्रीः सदा केशवमूर्तिमाया विश्वम्भरा या सकलं बिभर्ति ।
ह्रीर्योगिनी या महिता मनोज्ञा सा त्वं नमस्ते परमात्मसारे ॥ 55 ॥
1.m: You who are always Śrī, the Māyā of Keśava's form, the all-bearer who sustains everything, / who are Hrī, Yoginī, honored and delightful—homage to you, the essence of the Supreme Self!

1.s:
yāmādipūrve hṛdi yogino yāṃ vibhāvayanti pramitipratītām |
prakāśaśuddhādiyutāṃ virāṇāṃ sā tvaṃ hi vidyā vividhāvalambā || 56 ||
1.d:
यामादिपूर्वे हृदि योगिनो यां विभावयन्ति प्रमितिप्रतीताम् ।
प्रकाशशुद्धादियुतां विराणां सा त्वं हि विद्या विविधावलम्बा ॥ 56 ॥
1.m: Whom yogins meditate upon in their heart preceded by restraint, recognized through valid cognition, / endowed with luminous purity and the rest for heroes—you are indeed Vidyā, having diverse supports!

1.s:
kūṭasthamavyaktamacintyarūpaṃ tvaṃ bibhratī kālamayaṃ jaganti |
vikārabījaṃ prakaroṣi nityaṃ pratnāni nyūtānyatha madhyamāni || 57 ||
1.d:
कूटस्थमव्यक्तमचिन्त्यरूपं त्वं बिभ्रती कालमयं जगन्ति ।
विकारबीजं प्रकरोषि नित्यं प्रत्नानि न्यूतान्यथ मध्यमानि ॥ 57 ॥
1.m: Bearing the worlds, unchanging, unmanifest, of inconceivable form, made of time, / you eternally produce the seed of modification—ancient, intermediate, and recent.

1.s:
sattvaṃ rajo'tho tama ityamīṣāṃ vikārahīnā samavasthitiryā |
sā tvaṃ guṇānāṃ jagadekaheturbāhyāntarālaṃ bhavatīva yāti || 58 ||
1.d:
सत्त्वं रजोऽथो तम इत्यमीषां विकारहीना समवस्थितिर्या ।
सा त्वं गुणानां जगदेकहेतुर्बाह्यान्तरालं भवतीव याति ॥ 58 ॥
1.m: That which is the state of equilibrium, free from modification, of these [qualities], sattva, rajas, and tamas— / that you are, the sole cause of the qualities of the universe, who enters, as it were, the external and internal.

1.s:
aśeṣajagatāṃ bīje jñeyajñānasvarūpiṇi |
jagaddhitāya jagatāṃ viṣṇumāye namo'stute || 59 ||
1.d:
अशेषजगतां बीजे ज्ञेयज्ञानस्वरूपिणि ।
जगद्धिताय जगतां विष्णुमाये नमोऽस्तुते ॥ 59 ॥
1.m: O seed of all worlds, whose nature is the known and knowing, / for the welfare of the world, Viṣṇumāyā of the worlds, homage to you!

1.s:
ityākarṇya vacastasya kālī lokavimohinī |
brahmāṇamūce jagatāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ ghanaśabdavat || 60 ||
1.d:
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य काली लोकविमोहिनी ।
ब्रह्माणमूचे जगतां स्रष्टारं घनशब्दवत् ॥ 60 ॥
1.m: Having heard his speech, Kālī, deluder of the worlds, / spoke to Brahmā, the creator of the worlds, with a voice like a cloud:

1.s: devyuvāca
1.d: देव्युवाच

1.s:
brahman kimarthaṃ bhavatā stutāhamavadhāraya |
ucyatāṃ yadadhṛṣtyo'sti tacchrīghraṃ purato mama || 61 ||
1.d:
ब्रह्मन् किमर्थं भवता स्तुताहमवधारय ।
उच्यतां यदधृष्त्योऽस्ति तच्छ्रीघ्रं पुरतो मम ॥ 61 ॥
1.m: O Brahman, state for what reason you have praised me. / Let whatever has to be accomplished be spoken quickly before me.

1.s:
pratyakṣaṃ mayi jātāyāṃ siddhiḥ kāryasya niścitā |
tasmātte vāñchitaṃ brūhi yat kariṣyāmi bhāvitā || 62 ||
1.d:
प्रत्यक्षं मयि जातायां सिद्धिः कार्यस्य निश्चिता ।
तस्मात्ते वाञ्छितं ब्रूहि यत् करिष्यामि भाविता ॥ 62 ॥
1.m: Since I have become visible, the success of the task is certain. / Therefore, speak your desire, which I, being honored, will fulfill.

1.s: brahmovāca
1.d: ब्रह्मोवाच

1.s:
ekaścarati bhūteśo na dvitīyāṃ samīhate |
taṃ mohaya yathā dārān svayaṃ sa ca jighṛkṣati || 63 ||
1.d:
एकश्चरति भूतेशो न द्वितीयां समीहते ।
तं मोहय यथा दारान् स्वयं स च जिघृक्षति ॥ 63 ॥
1.m: The lord of creatures wanders alone and desires no partner. / Delude him so that he himself will wish to take a wife.

1.s:
tvadṛte tasya no kācid bhaviṣyati manoharā |
tasmāttvamekarūpeṇa bhavasya bhava mohanī || 64 ||
1.d:
त्वदृते तस्य नो काचिद् भविष्यति मनोहरा ।
तस्मात्त्वमेकरूपेण भवस्य भव मोहनी ॥ 64 ॥
1.m: Without you, no woman will captivate his heart. / Therefore, in a single form, become the enchantress of Bhava.

1.s:
yathā dhṛtaśarīrā tvaṃ lakṣmīrūpeṇa keśavam |
āmodayasi viśvasya hitāyaitaṃ tathā kuru || 65 ||
1.d:
यथा धृतशरीरा त्वं लक्ष्मीरूपेण केशवम् ।
आमोदयसि विश्वस्य हितायैतं तथा कुरु ॥ 65 ॥
1.m: Just as, assuming a body in the form of Lakṣmī, you / delight Keśava, so do this for the welfare of the universe.

1.s:
kāntābhilāṣamātraṃ me nininda vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ sa vanitāṃ svecchayā saṃgrahīṣyati || 66 ||
1.d:
कान्ताभिलाषमात्रं मे निनिन्द वृषभध्वजः ।
कथं पुनः स वनितां स्वेच्छया संग्रहीष्यति ॥ 66 ॥
1.m: He whose banner bears a bull reproached my mere desire for a beloved; / how then will he take a woman of his own will?

1.s:
hare'gṛhītakānte tu kathaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ pravartate |
ādyantamadhyahetau ca tasmiñchambhau virāgiṇi || 67 ||
1.d:
हरेऽगृहीतकान्ते तु कथं सृष्टिः प्रवर्तते ।
आद्यन्तमध्यहेतौ च तस्मिञ्छम्भौ विरागिणि ॥ 67 ॥
1.m: If Hara does not take a beloved, how will creation proceed, / when Śambhu, the cause of the beginning, end, and middle, is free from passion?

1.s:
iti cintāparo nāhaṃ tvadanyaṃ śaraṇantviha |
labdhavāṃstena viśvasya hitāyaitat kuruṣva me || 68 ||
1.d:
इति चिन्तापरो नाहं त्वदन्यं शरणन्त्विह ।
लब्धवांस्तेन विश्वस्य हितायैतत् कुरुष्व मे ॥ 68 ॥
1.m: Filled with this anxiety, I have found no refuge here other than you; / therefore, do this for me, for the welfare of the universe.

1.s:
na viṣṇurasya mohāya na lakṣmīrna manobhavaḥ |
na cāpyahaṃ jaganmātastasmāt tvaṃ mohayeśvaram || 69 ||
1.d:
न विष्णुरस्य मोहाय न लक्ष्मीर्न मनोभवः ।
न चाप्यहं जगन्मातस्तस्मात् त्वं मोहयेश्वरम् ॥ 69 ॥
1.m: Viṣṇu cannot delude him, nor Lakṣmī, nor Manobhava, / nor can I, O Mother of the universe! Therefore, delude Īśvara yourself.

1.s:
kīrtistvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā tvaṃ hrīryatātmanām |
yathā viṣṇoḥ priyaikā tvaṃ tathā sammohayeśvaram || 70 ||
1.d:
कीर्तिस्त्वं सर्वभूतानां यथा त्वं ह्रीर्यतात्मनाम् ।
यथा विष्णोः प्रियैका त्वं तथा सम्मोहयेश्वरम् ॥ 70 ॥
1.m: As you are the glory of all beings, as you are modesty to the self-restrained, / as you are Viṣṇu's sole beloved, so thoroughly delude Īśvara.

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
atha brahmāṇamābhāṣya kālī yogamayī punaḥ |
yaduvāca mahābhāgāstacchṛṇvantu dvijottamāḥ || 71 ||
1.d:
अथ ब्रह्माणमाभाष्य काली योगमयी पुनः ।
यदुवाच महाभागास्तच्छृण्वन्तु द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 71 ॥
1.m: Then, having addressed Brahmā, what Kālī, full of yoga, / said again, O fortunate ones, hear that, best of the twice-born:

1.s:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe kālīstutau pañcamo'yāyaḥ |
ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ
1.d:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे कालीस्तुतौ पञ्चमोऽयायः ।
षष्ठोऽध्यायः
1.m: Thus ends the fifth chapter, on the praise of Kālī, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / The sixth chapter.

1.s: devyuvāca
1.d: देव्युवाच

1.s:
yaduktaṃ bhavatā brahman samastaṃ satyameva tat |
madṛte mohayitrīha śaṃkarasya na vidyate || 1 ||
1.d:
यदुक्तं भवता ब्रह्मन् समस्तं सत्यमेव तत् ।
मदृते मोहयित्रीह शंकरस्य न विद्यते ॥ 1 ॥
1.m: All that which was spoken by you, O Brahman, is indeed true; / except for me, there is no enchantress of Śaṃkara here.

1.s:
hare'gṛhītadāre tu sṛṣṭirnaiṣā sanātanī |
bhaviṣyatīti tat satyaṃ bhavatā pratipāditam || 2 ||
1.d:
हरेऽगृहीतदारे तु सृष्टिर्नैषा सनातनी ।
भविष्यतीति तत् सत्यं भवता प्रतिपादितम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.m: If Hara does not take a wife, this eternal creation / will not come to be—that truth has been demonstrated by you.

1.s:
mayāpi ca mahān yatno vidyate'sya jagatpateḥ |
tvadvākyād dviguṇo me'dya prayatno'bhūt sunirbharaḥ || 3 ||
1.d:
मयापि च महान् यत्नो विद्यतेऽस्य जगत्पतेः ।
त्वद्वाक्याद् द्विगुणो मेऽद्य प्रयत्नोऽभूत् सुनिर्भरः ॥ 3 ॥
1.m: Great effort has also been made by me toward this lord of the universe; / through your word, my intense exertion today has become doubled.

1.s:
ahaṃ tathā yatiṣyāmi yathā dāraparigraham |
haraḥ kariṣyatyavaśaḥ svayameva vimohitaḥ || 4 ||
1.d:
अहं तथा यतिष्यामि यथा दारपरिग्रहम् ।
हरः करिष्यत्यवशः स्वयमेव विमोहितः ॥ 4 ॥
1.m: I will strive in such a way that Hara, overwhelmed, / deluded, will himself take a wife.

1.s:
cārvī mūrtimahaṃ dhṛtvā tasyaiva vaśavartinī |
bhaviṣyāmi mahābhāga yathā viṣṇorharipriyā || 5 ||
1.d:
चार्वी मूर्तिमहं धृत्वा तस्यैव वशवर्तिनी ।
भविष्यामि महाभाग यथा विष्णोर्हरिप्रिया ॥ 5 ॥
1.m: Assuming a lovely form, I will be subservient to him, / O highly fortunate one, just as Haripriyā is to Viṣṇu.

1.s:
yathā so'pi mamaiveha vaśavartī sadā bhavet |
tathā cāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yathetarajanaṃ haram || 6 ||
1.d:
यथा सोऽपि ममैवेह वशवर्ती सदा भवेत् ।
तथा चाहं करिष्यामि यथेतरजनं हरम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.m: And I will act in such a way that he too will always be subservient / to me here, [making] Hara like any ordinary person.

1.s:
pratisargādi madhyaṃ tamahaṃ śambhuṃ nirākulam |
strīrūpeṇānuyāsyāmi viśeṣeṇānyato vidhe || 7 ||
1.d:
प्रतिसर्गादि मध्यं तमहं शम्भुं निराकुलम् ।
स्त्रीरूपेणानुयास्यामि विशेषेणान्यतो विधे ॥ 7 ॥
1.m: I will pursue that untroubled Śambhu, who is the beginning and middle of each creation, / in the form of a woman, especially through another [means], O Vidhi.

1.s:
utpannā dakṣajāyāyāṃ cārurūpeṇa śaṃkaram |
ahaṃ sabhājayiṣyāmi pratisargaṃ pitāmaha || 12 ||
1.d:
उत्पन्ना दक्षजायायां चारुरूपेण शंकरम् ।
अहं सभाजयिष्यामि प्रतिसर्गं पितामह ॥ 12 ॥
1.m: Born of the wife of Dakṣa with a beautiful form, / I will honor Śaṃkara in every creation, O Grandfather.

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
iti tasmai samābhāṣya brahmaṇe dvijasattamāḥ |
vīkṣyamāṇā jagatsraṣṭrā tatraivāntardadhe tataḥ || 13 ||
1.d:
इति तस्मै समाभाष्य ब्रह्मणे द्विजसत्तमाः ।
वीक्ष्यमाणा जगत्स्रष्ट्रा तत्रैवान्तर्दधे ततः ॥ 13 ॥
1.m: Having thus addressed Brahmā, O best of the twice-born, / while being watched by the creator of the world, she vanished right there.

1.s:
tasyāmantarhitāyānnu dhātā lokapitāmahaḥ |
jagāma tatra bhagavān sthito yatra manobhavaḥ || 14 ||
1.d:
तस्यामन्तर्हितायान्नु धाता लोकपितामहः ।
जगाम तत्र भगवान् स्थितो यत्र मनोभवः ॥ 14 ॥
1.m: Now, when she had vanished, Dhātṛ, the grandfather of the worlds, / the blessed lord, went to where Manobhava was staying.

1.s:
mudito'tyarthamabhavanmahāmāyāvacaḥ smaran |
kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānaṃ mene ca munipuṅgavāḥ || 15 ||
1.d:
मुदितोऽत्यर्थमभवन्महामायावचः स्मरन् ।
कृतकृत्यं तदात्मानं मेने च मुनिपुङ्गवाः ॥ 15 ॥
1.m: He became exceedingly glad, remembering the words of Mahāmāyā, / and considered his purpose accomplished, O foremost of sages.

1.s:
atha dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ virañci madanastathā |
gacchantaṃ haṃsayānena cābhyuttasthau tvarānvitaḥ || 16 ||
1.d:
अथ दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं विरञ्चि मदनस्तथा ।
गच्छन्तं हंसयानेन चाभ्युत्तस्थौ त्वरान्वितः ॥ 16 ॥
1.m: Then, seeing the great-souled Viriñci / approaching on his swan-vehicle, Madana rose up in haste.

1.s:
āsannaṃ tamathāsādya harṣotphullavilocanaḥ |
vavande sarvalokeśaṃ modayuktaṃ manobhavaḥ || 17 ||
1.d:
आसन्नं तमथासाद्य हर्षोत्फुल्लविलोचनः ।
ववन्दे सर्वलोकेशं मोदयुक्तं मनोभवः ॥ 17 ॥
1.m: Approaching him as he came near, his eyes wide open with joy, / Manobhava bowed down to the lord of all worlds who was filled with delight.

1.s:
athāha bhagavān dhātā prītyā madhuragadgadam |
madanaṃ modayan sūktaṃ yad devyā viṣṇumāyayā || 18 ||
1.d:
अथाह भगवान् धाता प्रीत्या मधुरगद्गदम् ।
मदनं मोदयन् सूक्तं यद् देव्या विष्णुमायया ॥ 18 ॥
1.m: Then the blessed Dhātṛ, out of love, with a voice sweet and faltering [with emotion], / gladdening Madana, spoke what had been well spoken by the goddess Viṣṇumāyā.

1.s: brahmovāca
1.d: ब्रह्मोवाच

1.s:
yadāha vatsa śarvasya mohane tvaṃ purā vacaḥ |
anumohanakartrī yā tāṃ sṛjeti manobhava || 19 ||
1.d:
यदाह वत्स शर्वस्य मोहने त्वं पुरा वचः ।
अनुमोहनकर्त्री या तां सृजेति मनोभव ॥ 19 ॥
1.m: Child, the word you spoke long ago regarding the deluding of Śarva: / 'Create her who will cause [his] secondary delusion, O Manobhava'—

1.s:
tadarthaṃ saṃstutā devī yoganidrā jaganmayī |
ekatānena manasā mayā mandarakandare || 20 ||
1.d:
तदर्थं संस्तुता देवी योगनिद्रा जगन्मयी ।
एकतानेन मनसा मया मन्दरकन्दरे ॥ 20 ॥
1.m: for that purpose, the goddess Yoganidrā, who embodies the universe, / was praised by me with single-minded attention in a cave of Mandara.

1.s:
svayameva tayā vatsa pratyakṣībhūtayā mama |
tuṣṭayāṅgīkṛtaṃ śambhurmohanīyo mayeti vai || 21 ||
1.d:
स्वयमेव तया वत्स प्रत्यक्षीभूतया मम ।
तुष्टयाङ्गीकृतं शम्भुर्मोहनीयो मयेति वै ॥ 21 ॥
1.m:
Manifesting herself directly before me, child, she was pleased
and agreed: 'Śambhu must indeed be enchanted by me.'

1.s:
tayā ca dakṣabhavane sa samutpannayā haraḥ |
mohanīyastu na cirāditi satyaṃ manobhava || 22 ||
1.d:
तया च दक्षभवने स समुत्पन्नया हरः ।
मोहनीयस्तु न चिरादिति सत्यं मनोभव ॥ 22 ॥
1.m:
And born in the house of Dakṣa, Hara
is to be enchanted by her without delay; this is the truth, O Manobhava.

1.s: madana uvāca
1.d: मदन उवाच

1.s:
brahman kā yoganidreti vikhyātā yā jaganmayī |
kathaṃ tasyā haro vaśyaḥ kāryastapasi samsthitaḥ || 23 ||
1.d:
ब्रह्मन् का योगनिद्रेति विख्याता या जगन्मयी ।
कथं तस्या हरो वश्यः कार्यस्तपसि सम्स्थितः ॥ 23 ॥
1.m:
O Brahman, who is she known as Yoganidrā, who embodies the universe?
How can Hara, steadfast in asceticism, be brought under her power?

1.s:
kimprabhāvātha sā devī kā vā sā kutra saṃsthitā |
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto lokapitāmaha || 24 ||
1.d:
किम्प्रभावाथ सा देवी का वा सा कुत्र संस्थिता ।
तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वत्तो लोकपितामह ॥ 24 ॥
1.m:
What is the power of that goddess, who is she, and where does she dwell?
I wish to hear that from you, O grandfather of the worlds.

1.s:
yasya tyaktasamādhestu na kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭigocare |
śaknumo'pi vayaṃ sthātuṃ taṃ kasmāt sā vimohayet || 25 ||
1.d:
यस्य त्यक्तसमाधेस्तु न क्षणं दृष्टिगोचरे ।
शक्नुमोऽपि वयं स्थातुं तं कस्मात् सा विमोहयेत् ॥ 25 ॥
1.m:
Even when he has relinquished contemplation, we are not able
to stand within the range of his sight for even a moment; why would she enchant him?

1.s:
jvaladagniprakāśākṣaṃ jaṭārājikarālitam |
śūlinaṃ vīkṣya kaḥ sthātuṃ brahman śaknoti tatpuraḥ || 26 ||
1.d:
ज्वलदग्निप्रकाशाक्षं जटाराजिकरालितम् ।
शूलिनं वीक्ष्य कः स्थातुं ब्रह्मन् शक्नोति तत्पुरः ॥ 26 ॥
1.m:
Whose eyes blaze with the radiance of blazing fire, who is formidable with a mass of matted hair—
beholding the wielder of the trident, O Brahman, who is able to stand before him?

1.s:
tasya tādṛksvarūpasya samyaṅmohanavāñchayā |
mayābhyupetaṃ tāṃ śrutu mahamicchāmi tattvataḥ || 27 ||
1.d:
तस्य तादृक्स्वरूपस्य सम्यङ्मोहनवाञ्छया ।
मयाभ्युपेतं तां श्रुतु महमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥ 27 ॥
1.m:
Out of a desire for his complete enchantment, having such a nature,
I have approached; I wish to hear of her in truth.

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
manobhavasya vacanaṃ śrutvātha caturānanaḥ |
vivakṣurapi tadvākyaṃ śrutvānutsāhakāraṇam || 28 ||
1.d:
मनोभवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वाथ चतुराननः ।
विवक्षुरपि तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वानुत्साहकारणम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.m:
Then, hearing the words of Manobhava, the four-faced [god],
though desiring to speak, upon hearing his speech, which was a cause of discouragement,

1.s:
śarvasya mohane brahmā cintāviṣṭo bhavannahi |
samartho mohayitumiti niḥśvāsa muhurmuhuḥ || 29 ||
1.d:
शर्वस्य मोहने ब्रह्मा चिन्ताविष्टो भवन्नहि ।
समर्थो मोहयितुमिति निःश्वास मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ 29 ॥
1.m:
Brahmā was seized with anxiety regarding the enchanting of Śarva: 'I am not
able to enchant [him]'—so he sighed again and again.

1.s:
niḥśvāsamārutāttasya nānārūpā mahābalāḥ |
jātā gaṇā lolajihvā lolāścāti bhayaṃkarāḥ || 30 ||
1.d:
निःश्वासमारुतात्तस्य नानारूपा महाबलाः ।
जाता गणा लोलजिह्वा लोलाश्चाति भयंकराः ॥ 30 ॥
1.m:
From the wind of his sigh, of diverse forms and endowed with great strength,
the gaṇas were born, with restless tongues, agitated and exceedingly terrifying.

1.s:
turaṃgavadanāḥ kecit kecid gajamukhāstathā |
siṃhavyāghramukhāścānye śvavarāhakharānanāḥ || 31 ||
1.d:
तुरंगवदनाः केचित् केचिद् गजमुखास्तथा ।
सिंहव्याघ्रमुखाश्चान्ये श्ववराहखराननाः ॥ 31 ॥
1.m:
Some had horse faces, and some had elephant faces;
others had lion and tiger faces, or dog, boar, and donkey faces.

1.s:
ṛkṣamārjāradavadanāḥ śarabhāsyāḥ śukānanāḥ |
plavagomāyuvaktrāśca sarīsṛpamukhāḥ pare || 32 ||
1.d:
ऋक्षमार्जारदवदनाः शरभास्याः शुकाननाः ।
प्लवगोमायुवक्त्राश्च सरीसृपमुखाः परे ॥ 32 ॥
1.m:
Some had bear and cat faces, śarabha faces, and parrot faces;
others had monkey and jackal faces, and others had reptile faces.

1.s:
gorūpā gomukhāḥ kecittathā pakṣimukhāḥ pare |
mahādīrghā mahāhrasvā mahāsthūlā mahākṛśāḥ || 33 ||
1.d:
गोरूपा गोमुखाः केचित्तथा पक्षिमुखाः परे ।
महादीर्घा महाह्रस्वा महास्थूला महाकृशाः ॥ 33 ॥
1.m:
Some had cattle bodies, some had cattle faces, and others had bird faces;
some were extremely tall, some extremely short, some extremely fat, some extremely thin.

1.s:
piṅgākṣā virālākṣāśca tryakṣaikākṣā mahodarāḥ |
ekakarṇāstrikarṇāśca catuṣkarṇāstathā pare || 34 ||
1.d:
पिङ्गाक्षा विरालाक्षाश्च त्र्यक्षैकाक्षा महोदराः ।
एककर्णास्त्रिकर्णाश्च चतुष्कर्णास्तथा परे ॥ 34 ॥
1.m:
Some had tawny eyes, some cat-like eyes, some three eyes, some one eye, and some had huge bellies;
some had one ear, some three ears, and others had four ears.

1.s:
sthūlakarṇā mahākarṇā bahukarṇā vikarṇakāḥ |
dīrghākṣāḥ sthūlanetrāśca sūkṣmanetrā vidṛṣṭayaḥ || 35 ||
1.d:
स्थूलकर्णा महाकर्णा बहुकर्णा विकर्णकाः ।
दीर्घाक्षाः स्थूलनेत्राश्च सूक्ष्मनेत्रा विदृष्टयः ॥ 35 ॥
1.m:
Some had thick ears, some huge ears, some many ears, and some were earless;
some had long eyes, some thick eyes, some minute eyes, and some were sightless.

1.s:
catuṣpādāḥ pañcapādāstripādaikapadāstathā |
hrasvapādā dīrghapādāḥ sthūlapādā mahāpadāḥ || 36 ||
1.d:
चतुष्पादाः पञ्चपादास्त्रिपादैकपदास्तथा ।
ह्रस्वपादा दीर्घपादाः स्थूलपादा महापदाः ॥ 36 ॥
1.m:
Some were four-footed, some five-footed, some three-footed, and some one-footed;
some had short feet, some long feet, some thick feet, and some large feet.

1.s:
ekahastāścaturhastā dvihastāstriśayāstathā |
vihastāśca virūpākṣā godhikākṛtayaḥ pare || 37 ||
1.d:
एकहस्ताश्चतुर्हस्ता द्विहस्तास्त्रिशयास्तथा ।
विहस्ताश्च विरूपाक्षा गोधिकाकृतयः परे ॥ 37 ॥
1.m:
Some had one arm, some four arms, some two arms, and some three arms;
some were armless, some deformed-eyed, and others had the form of monitor lizards.

1.s:
manuṣyākṛtayaḥ kecicchuśumāramukhāstathā |
krauñcākārā vakākārā haṃsasārasarūpiṇaḥ |
tathaiva madgukurarakaṅkakākamukhāstathā || 38 ||
1.d:
मनुष्याकृतयः केचिच्छुशुमारमुखास्तथा ।
क्रौञ्चाकारा वकाकारा हंससारसरूपिणः ।
तथैव मद्गुकुररकङ्ककाकमुखास्तथा ॥ 38 ॥

1.s:
arddhanīlā arddharaktāḥ kapilāḥ piṅgalāstathā |
nīlāḥ śuklāstathā pītā haritāścitrarūpiṇaḥ || 69 ||
1.d:
अर्द्धनीला अर्द्धरक्ताः कपिलाः पिङ्गलास्तथा ।
नीलाः शुक्लास्तथा पीता हरिताश्चित्ररूपिणः ॥ 69 ॥
1.m:
Some were half blue, some half red, some brown, and some tawny;
some blue, some white, some yellow, some green, and variegated in form.

1.s:
avādayanta te śaṅkhān paṭahān parivādinaḥ |
mṛdaṅgān ḍiḍimāṃścaiva gomukhān paṇavāṃstathā || 40 ||
1.d:
अवादयन्त ते शङ्खान् पटहान् परिवादिनः ।
मृदङ्गान् डिडिमांश्चैव गोमुखान् पणवांस्तथा ॥ 40 ॥
1.m:
They sounded conches, drums, lutes,
mṛdaṅgas, ḍiḍimas, gomukhas, and paṇavas.

1.s:
śarvasya mohane brahmā cintāviṣṭo bhavannahi |
samartho mohayitumiti niḥśvāsa muhurmuhuḥ || 29 ||
1.d:
शर्वस्य मोहने ब्रह्मा चिन्ताविष्टो भवन्नहि ।
समर्थो मोहयितुमिति निःश्वास मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ 29 ॥
1.m:
Brahmā was seized with anxiety regarding the enchanting of Śarva: 'I am not
able to enchant [him]'—so he sighed again and again.

1.s:
niḥśvāsamārutāttasya nānārūpā mahābalāḥ |
jātā gaṇā lolajihvā lolāścāti bhayaṃkarāḥ || 30 ||
1.d:

जाता गणा लोलजिह्वा लोलाश्चाति भयंकराः ॥ 30 ॥
1.m:
From the wind of his sigh, of diverse forms and endowed with great strength,
the gaṇas were born, with restless tongues, agitated and exceedingly terrifying.

1.s:
turaṃgavadanāḥ kecit kecid gajamukhāstathā |
siṃhavyāghramukhāścānye śvavarāhakharānanāḥ || 31 ||

सिंहव्याघ्रमुखाश्चान्ये श्ववराहखराननाः ॥ 31 ॥
1.m:
Some had horse faces, and some had elephant faces;
others had lion and tiger faces, or dog, boar, and donkey faces.

1.s:
ṛkṣamārjāradavadanāḥ śarabhāsyāḥ śukānanāḥ |
plavagomāyuvaktrāśca sarīsṛpamukhāḥ pare || 32 ||

प्लवगोमायुवक्त्राश्च सरीसृपमुखाः परे ॥ 32 ॥

Some had bear and cat faces, śarabha faces, and parrot faces;
others had monkey and jackal faces, and others had reptile faces.

1.s:

mahādīrghā mahāhrasvā mahāsthūlā mahākṛśāḥ || 33 ||

महादीर्घा महाह्रस्वा महास्थूला महाकृशाः ॥ 33 ॥
1.m:
Some had cattle bodies, some had cattle faces, and others had bird faces;
some were extremely tall, some extremely short, some extremely fat, some extremely thin.

1.s:
piṅgākṣā virālākṣāśca tryakṣaikākṣā mahodarāḥ |
ekakarṇāstrikarṇāśca catuṣkarṇāstathā pare || 34 ||
1.d:
पिङ्गाक्षा विरालाक्षाश्च त्र्यक्षैकाक्षा महोदराः ।
एककर्णास्त्रिकर्णाश्च चतुष्कर्णास्तथा परे ॥ 34 ॥
1.m:
Some had tawny eyes, some cat-like eyes, some three eyes, some one eye, and some had huge bellies;
some had one ear, some three ears, and others had four ears.

1.s:
sthūlakarṇā mahākarṇā bahukarṇā vikarṇakāḥ |
dīrghākṣāḥ sthūlanetrāśca sūkṣmanetrā vidṛṣṭayaḥ || 35 ||
1.d:
स्थूलकर्णा महाकर्णा बहुकर्णा विकर्णकाः ।
दीर्घाक्षाः स्थूलनेत्राश्च सूक्ष्मनेत्रा विदृष्टयः ॥ 35 ॥
1.m:
Some had thick ears, some huge ears, some many ears, and some were earless;
some had long eyes, some thick eyes, some minute eyes, and some were sightless.

1.s:
catuṣpādāḥ pañcapādāstripādaikapadāstathā |
hrasvapādā dīrghapādāḥ sthūlapādā mahāpadāḥ || 36 ||
1.d:
चतुष्पादाः पञ्चपादास्त्रिपादैकपदास्तथा ।
ह्रस्वपादा दीर्घपादाः स्थूलपादा महापदाः ॥ 36 ॥
1.m:
Some were four-footed, some five-footed, some three-footed, and some one-footed;
some had short feet, some long feet, some thick feet, and some large feet.

1.s:
ekahastāścaturhastā dvihastāstriśayāstathā |
vihastāśca virūpākṣā godhikākṛtayaḥ pare || 37 ||
1.d:
एकहस्ताश्चतुर्हस्ता द्विहस्तास्त्रिशयास्तथा ।
विहस्ताश्च विरूपाक्षा गोधिकाकृतयः परे ॥ 37 ॥
1.m:
Some had one arm, some four arms, some two arms, and some three arms;
some were armless, some deformed-eyed, and others had the form of monitor lizards.

1.s:
manuṣyākṛtayaḥ kecicchuśumāramukhāstathā |
krauñcākārā bakākārā haṃsasārasarūpiṇaḥ |
tathaiva madgukurarakaṅkakākamukhāstathā || 38 ||
1.d:
मनुष्याकृतयः केचिच्छुशुमारमुखास्तथा ।
क्रौञ्चाकारा बकाकारा हंससारसरूपिणः ।
तथैव मद्गुकुररकङ्ककाकमुखास्तथा ॥ 38 ॥

1.s:
arddhanīlā arddharaktāḥ kapilāḥ piṅgalāstathā |
nīlāḥ śuklāstathā pītā haritāścitrarūpiṇaḥ || 69 ||
1.d:
अर्द्धनीला अर्द्धरक्ताः कपिलाः पिङ्गलास्तथा ।
नीलाः शुक्लास्तथा पीता हरिताश्चित्ररूपिणः ॥ 69 ॥
1.m:
Some were half blue, some half red, some brown, and some tawny;
some blue, some white, some yellow, some green, and variegated in form.

1.s:
avādayanta te śaṅkhān paṭahān parivādinaḥ |
mṛdaṅgān ḍiḍimāṃścaiva gomukhān paṇavāṃstathā || 40 ||
1.d:
अवादयन्त ते शङ्खान् पटहान् परिवादिनः ।
मृदङ्गान् डिडिमांश्चैव गोमुखान् पणवांस्तथा ॥ 40 ॥
1.m:
They sounded conches, drums, lutes,
mṛdaṅgas, ḍiḍimas, gomukhas, and paṇavas.

1.s:
sarve jaṭābhiḥ piṅgābhistuṅgābhiśca karālitāḥ |
nirantarābhirviprendrā gaṇāḥ syandanagāminaḥ || 41 ||
1.d:
सर्वे जटाभिः पिङ्गाभिस्तुङ्गाभिश्च करालिताः ।
निरन्तराभिर्विप्रेन्द्रा गणाः स्यन्दनगामिनः ॥ 41 ॥
1.m:
All were formidable with tawny and towering matted locks,
dense, O best of Brahmins, riding in chariots were those gaṇas.

1.s:
śūlahastāḥ pāśahastāḥ khaḍgahastā dhanurdharāḥ |
śaktyaṅku śagadāvāṇa-paṭṭiśaprāsapāṇayaḥ || 42 ||
1.d:
शूलहस्ताः पाशहस्ताः खड्गहस्ता धनुर्धराः ।
शक्त्यङ्कु शगदावाण-पट्टिशप्रासपाणयः ॥ 42 ॥
1.m:
Holding tridents, holding nooses, holding swords, bearing bows,
with spears, goads, maces, arrows, paṭṭiśas, and javelins in hand,

1.s:
nānāyudhā mahānādaṃ kurvantaste mahābalāḥ |
māraya cchedayetyūcurbrahmaṇaḥ purato gatāḥ || 43 ||
1.d:
नानायुधा महानादं कुर्वन्तस्ते महाबलाः ।
मारय च्छेदयेत्यूचुर्ब्रह्मणः पुरतो गताः ॥ 43 ॥
1.m:
bearing various weapons, making a great roar, endowed with great strength,
they went before Brahmā and cried, 'Kill! Cut!'

1.s:
teṣāntu vadatāṃ yatra māraya chedayetyuta |
yoganindrā prabhāvāt sa vidhirvaktuṃ pracakrame || 44 ||
1.d:
तेषान्तु वदतां यत्र मारय छेदयेत्युत ।
योगनिन्द्रा प्रभावात् स विधिर्वक्तुं प्रचक्रमे ॥ 44 ॥
1.m:
While they were shouting, 'Kill! Cut!',
Vidhi began to speak through the power of Yoganidrā.

1.s:
atha brahmāṇamābhāṣya tān dṛṣṭvā madano gaṇān |
uvāca vārayan vaktuṃ gaṇānāmagrataḥ smaraḥ || 45 ||
1.d:
अथ ब्रह्माणमाभाष्य तान् दृष्ट्वा मदनो गणान् ।
उवाच वारयन् वक्तुं गणानामग्रतः स्मरः ॥ 45 ॥
1.m:
Then, having addressed Brahmā upon seeing those gaṇas,
Smara spoke, restraining the gaṇas before him from speaking.

1.s: madana uvāca
1.d: मदन उवाच

1.s:
kiṃ karma te kariṣyanti kutra sthāsyanti vā vidhe |
kinnāmadheyā ete vā tatraitān viniyojaya || 46 ||
1.d:
किं कर्म ते करिष्यन्ति कुत्र स्थास्यन्ति वा विधे ।
किन्नामधेया एते वा तत्रैतान् विनियोजय ॥ 46 ॥
1.m:
What work will they perform, or where will they dwell, O Vidhi?
What are their names? Assign them accordingly.

1.s:
niyojyaitānnije kṛtye sthānaṃ dattvā nāma ca |
kṛtvā paścātmahāmāyāprabhāvaṃ kathayasva me || 47 ||
1.d:
नियोज्यैतान्निजे कृत्ये स्थानं दत्त्वा नाम च ।
कृत्वा पश्चात्महामायाप्रभावं कथयस्व मे ॥ 47 ॥
1.m:
Having assigned them to their own task, having given them an abode and a name,
tell me afterwards of the power of Mahāmāyā.

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
atha tadvākyamākarṇya sarvalokapitāmahaḥ |
gaṇān samadanānāha teṣāṃ karmādikaṃ diśan || 48 ||
1.d:
अथ तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्य सर्वलोकपितामहः ।
गणान् समदनानाह तेषां कर्मादिकं दिशन् ॥ 48 ॥
1.m:
Then, having heard his speech, the grandfather of all the worlds
spoke to the gaṇas along with Madana, assigning their task and [other attributes]:

1.s: brahmovāca
1.d: ब्रह्मोवाच

1.s:
eta utpannamātrā hi mārayetyavadaṃstarām |
muhurmuhurato'mīṣāṃ nāma māreti jāyatām || 49 ||
1.d:
एत उत्पन्नमात्रा हि मारयेत्यवदंस्तराम् ।
मुहुर्मुहुरतोऽमीषां नाम मारेति जायताम् ॥ 49 ॥
1.m:
As soon as they were born, they cried out loudly: 'Kill!'
Again and again, therefore let the name of these [beings] be Māra.

1.s:
mārātmakatvādapyete mārāḥ santu ca nāmataḥ |
sadā vighnaṃ kariṣyanti jantūnāñca vinārcanam || 50 ||
1.d:
मारात्मकत्वादप्येते माराः सन्तु च नामतः ।
सदा विघ्नं करिष्यन्ति जन्तूनाञ्च विनार्चनम् ॥ 50 ॥
1.m:
Because their nature is killing, let them also be Māras by name.
They will always cause obstacles to living beings, unless worshipped.

1.s:
tavānugamanaṃ karma mukhyameṣāṃ manobhava |
yatra yatra bhavān yātā svakarmārthaṃ yadā yadā |
gantārastatra tatraite sāhāyyāya tadā tadā || 51 ||
1.d:
तवानुगमनं कर्म मुख्यमेषां मनोभव ।
यत्र यत्र भवान् याता स्वकर्मार्थं यदा यदा ।
गन्तारस्तत्र तत्रैते साहाय्याय तदा तदा ॥ 51 ॥
1.m:
Following you is their principal task, O Manobhava.
Wherever and whenever you go for the sake of your work,
there and then they will go to assist [you].

1.s:
cittodbhrāntiṃ kariṣyanti tvadastravaśavartinām |
jñānināṃ jñānamārgaña vighnayiṣyanti sarvadā || 52 ||
1.d:
चित्तोद्भ्रान्तिं करिष्यन्ति त्वदस्त्रवशवर्तिनाम् ।
ज्ञानिनां ज्ञानमार्गञ विघ्नयिष्यन्ति सर्वदा ॥ 52 ॥
1.m:
They will cause mental delusion to those who fall under the power of your weapon,
and they will always obstruct the path of knowledge for the wise.

1.s:
yathā sāṃsārikaṃ karma sarve kurvanti jantavaḥ |
tathā caite kariṣyanti savighnamapi sarvataḥ || 53 ||
1.d:
यथा सांसारिकं कर्म सर्वे कुर्वन्ति जन्तवः ।
तथा चैते करिष्यन्ति सविघ्नमपि सर्वतः ॥ 53 ॥
1.m: Just as all creatures perform worldly actions, / so these will bring it about, even beset with obstacles on all sides.

1.s:
ime sthāsyanti sarvatra veginaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ |
tvamevaiṣāṃ gaṇādhyakṣaḥ pañcayajñāṃśabhoginaḥ |
nityakriyāvatāṃ toyabhogino vai bhavantviti || 54 ||
1.d:
इमे स्थास्यन्ति सर्वत्र वेगिनः कामरूपिणः ।
त्वमेवैषां गणाध्यक्षः पञ्चयज्ञांशभोगिनः ।
नित्यक्रियावतां तोयभोगिनो वै भवन्त्विति ॥ 54 ॥
1.m: Swift and changing their form at will, they will abide everywhere. / You alone are the leader of these hosts, who partake of portions of the five sacrifices; / let them indeed be partakers of the water of those who perform the daily rites.”

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
iti śrutvā tu te sarve madanaṃ savidhiṃ tataḥ |
parivārya yathākāmaṃ tasthuḥ śrutvā nijāṃ gatim || 55 ||
1.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे मदनं सविधिं ततः ।
परिवार्य यथाकामं तस्थुः श्रुत्वा निजां गतिम् ॥ 55 ॥
1.m: Having heard this and learned their course of life, all of them / surrounded Madana and Vidhi, and stood as they wished.

1.s:
teṣāṃ varṇayituṃ śakyo bhuvi kiṃ munisattamāḥ |
māhātmyañca prabhāvañca te tapaḥśālino yataḥ || 56 ||
1.d:
तेषां वर्णयितुं शक्यो भुवि किं मुनिसत्तमाः ।
माहात्म्यञ्च प्रभावञ्च ते तपःशालिनो यतः ॥ 56 ॥
1.m: O best of sages, who on earth could describe / their majesty and their power, since they are rich in austerities?

1.s:
naiṣāṃ jāyā na tanayā niḥsamīhāḥ sadaiva hi |
nyāsino'pi mahātmānaḥ sarve ta ūrdhvaretasaḥ || 57 ||
1.d:
नैषां जाया न तनया निःसमीहाः सदैव हि ।
न्यासिनोऽपि महात्मानः सर्वे त ऊर्ध्वरेतसः ॥ 57 ॥
1.m: They have no wives and no sons, ever free from selfish desires; / though ascetics, these great-souled ones all have their seed drawn upward.

1.s:
tato brahmā prasannaḥ sa māhātmyaṃ madanāya ca |
gadituṃ yoganindrāyāḥ samyak samupacakrame || 58 ||
1.d:
ततो ब्रह्मा प्रसन्नः स माहात्म्यं मदनाय च ।
गदितुं योगनिन्द्रायाः सम्यक् समुपचक्रमे ॥ 58 ॥
1.m: Then the pleased Brahmā duly set about / declaring to Madana the majesty of Yoganidrā.

1.s: brahmovāca
1.d: ब्रह्मोवाच

1.s:
avyaktavyaktarūpeṇa rajaḥsattvatamoguṇaiḥ |
saṃvibhajyārthaṃ kurute viṣṇumāyeti socyate || 59 ||
1.d:
अव्यक्तव्यक्तरूपेण रजःसत्त्वतमोगुणैः ।
संविभज्यार्थं कुरुते विष्णुमायेति सोच्यते ॥ 59 ॥
1.m: Through unmanifest and manifest forms, by means of the qualities of rajas, sattva, and tamas, / she divides and accomplishes the goal; she is called Viṣṇumāyā.

1.s:
yā nimnāntasthalāmbhasthā jagadaṇḍakapālataḥ |
vibhajya puruṣaṃ yāti yoganidreti socyate || 60 ||
1.d:
या निम्नान्तस्थलाम्भस्था जगदण्डकपालतः ।
विभज्य पुरुषं याति योगनिद्रेति सोच्यते ॥ 60 ॥
1.m: Dwelling in the waters of the lower depths, having divided [creation] / from the shell of the cosmic egg, she approaches Puruṣa; she is called Yoganidrā.

1.s:
mantrāntarbhāvanaparā paramānandarūpiṇī |
yogināṃ sattvavidyāntaḥ sā nigadyā jaganmayī || 61 ||
1.d:
मन्त्रान्तर्भावनपरा परमानन्दरूपिणी ।
योगिनां सत्त्वविद्यान्तः सा निगद्या जगन्मयी ॥ 61 ॥
1.m: Devoted to meditation within mantras, having the form of supreme bliss, / she is within the knowledge of sattva of the yogins, celebrated as consisting of the world.

1.s:
garbhāntarjñānasampannaṃ preritaṃ sūtimārutaiḥ |
utpannaṃ jñānarahitaṃ kurute yā nirantaram || 62 ||
1.d:
गर्भान्तर्ज्ञानसम्पन्नं प्रेरितं सूतिमारुतैः ।
उत्पन्नं ज्ञानरहितं कुरुते या निरन्तरम् ॥ 62 ॥
1.m: When [a creature] endowed with knowledge in the womb is impelled by the winds of birth / and born, she constantly renders it devoid of knowledge.

1.s:
pūrvātipūrvaṃ sandhātuṃ saṃskāreṇa niyojya ca |
āhārādau tato mohaṃ mamatvaṃ jñānasaṃśayam || 63 ||
1.d:
पूर्वातिपूर्वं सन्धातुं संस्कारेण नियोज्य च ।
आहारादौ ततो मोहं ममत्वं ज्ञानसंशयम् ॥ 63 ॥
1.m: Connecting [it] with the impressions of the past and the most ancient past, and engaging [it] / in food and the like, she then [arouses] delusion, the sense of 'mine', and doubt about knowledge.

1.s:
krodhoparodhalobheṣu kṣiptvā kṣiptvā punaḥ punaḥ |
paścāt kāme niyojyāśu cintāyuktamaharniśam || 64 ||
1.d:
क्रोधोपरोधलोभेषु क्षिप्त्वा क्षिप्त्वा पुनः पुनः ।
पश्चात् कामे नियोज्याशु चिन्तायुक्तमहर्निशम् ॥ 64 ॥
1.m: Throwing [it] again and again into anger, obstruction, and greed, / and afterwards quickly engaging [it] in desire, beset with anxiety day and night,

1.s:
āmodayuktaṃ vyasanāsaktaṃ jantuṃ karoti yā |
mahāmāyeti sā proktā tena sā jagadīśvarī || 65 ||
1.d:
आमोदयुक्तं व्यसनासक्तं जन्तुं करोति या ।
महामायेति सा प्रोक्ता तेन सा जगदीश्वरी ॥ 65 ॥
1.m: she makes the creature joyful yet addicted to vice; / therefore is she called Mahāmāyā, the sovereign lady of the world.

1.s:
ahaṃkārādisaṃsaktasṛṣṭiprabhavabhāvinī |
utpattiritilokaiḥ sā kathyate'nantarūpiṇī || 66 ||
1.d:
अहंकारादिसंसक्तसृष्टिप्रभवभाविनी ।
उत्पत्तिरितिलोकैः सा कथ्यतेऽनन्तरूपिणी ॥ 66 ॥
1.m: Becoming the source of the creation connected with the ego and other [principles], / she, possessing endless forms, is called 'Birth' by the worlds.

1.s:
utpannamaṅkaraṃ bījād yathāpo meghasambhavāḥ |
prarohayati sā jantūṃstathotpannān prarohayet || 67 ||
1.d:
उत्पन्नमङ्करं बीजाद् यथापो मेघसम्भवाः ।
प्ररोहयति सा जन्तूंस्तथोत्पन्नान् प्ररोहयेत् ॥ 67 ॥
1.m: Just as the waters born of clouds make the sprout / shoot up from the seed, so does she make creatures shoot up once they are born.

1.s:
sā śaktiḥ sṛṣṭirūpā ca sarveṣāṃ khyātirīśvarī |
kṣamā kṣamāvatāṃ nityaṃ karuṇā sā dayāvatām || 68 ||
1.d:
सा शक्तिः सृष्टिरूपा च सर्वेषां ख्यातिरीश्वरी ।
क्षमा क्षमावतां नित्यं करुणा सा दयावताम् ॥ 68 ॥
1.m: She is the energy and the form of creation, the celebrated sovereign of all, / ever the forbearance of the forbearing, the compassion of the merciful.

1.s:
nityā sā nityarūpeṇa jagadgarbhe prakāśate |
jyotiḥsvarūpeṇa parā vyaktāvyaktaprakāśinī || 69 ||
1.d:
नित्या सा नित्यरूपेण जगद्गर्भे प्रकाशते ।
ज्योतिःस्वरूपेण परा व्यक्ताव्यक्तप्रकाशिनी ॥ 69 ॥
1.m: Eternal, she shines in the womb of the world with an eternal form; / supreme, having the nature of light, she illumines the manifest and unmanifest.

1.s:
sā yogināṃ muktiheturvidyārūpeṇa vaiṣṇavī |
sāṃsārikāṇāṃ saṃsārabandhahetuviparyayā || 70 ||
1.d:
सा योगिनां मुक्तिहेतुर्विद्यारूपेण वैष्णवी ।
सांसारिकाणां संसारबन्धहेतुविपर्यया ॥ 70 ॥
1.m: She is the cause of liberation for yogins, being Vaiṣṇavī in the form of knowledge; / for worldly people, as [her] contrary, she is the cause of bondage in saṃsāra.

1.s:
lakṣmīrūpeṇa kṛṣṇasya dvitīyā sumanoharā |
trayīrūpeṇa kaṇṭhasthā sadā mama manobhava || 71 ||
1.d:
लक्ष्मीरूपेण कृष्णस्य द्वितीया सुमनोहरा ।
त्रयीरूपेण कण्ठस्था सदा मम मनोभव ॥ 71 ॥
1.m: In the form of Lakṣmī she is the most charming partner of Kṛṣṇa; / in the form of the triple Veda, O Manobhava, she always abides in my throat.

1.s:
sarvatrasthā sarvagā divyamūrtirnityā devī sarvarūpā parākhyā |
kṛṣṇādīnāṃ sarvadā mohayitrī sā strīrūpeḥ sarvajantoḥ samantāt || 72 ||
1.d:
सर्वत्रस्था सर्वगा दिव्यमूर्तिर्नित्या देवी सर्वरूपा पराख्या ।
कृष्णादीनां सर्वदा मोहयित्री सा स्त्रीरूपेः सर्वजन्तोः समन्तात् ॥ 72 ॥
1.m: Abiding everywhere, going everywhere, having a divine form, the eternal Goddess, possessing all forms, called the Supreme, / she, the constant deluder of Kṛṣṇa and the rest, [dwells] in the forms of women all around every creature.

1.s: iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe yoganidrāstutau ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||
1.d: इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे योगनिद्रास्तुतौ षष्ठोऽध्यायः ॥
1.m: Thus ends the sixth chapter, in the praise of Yoganidrā, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa.

1.s: saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
1.d: सप्तमोऽध्यायः

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
atha brahmā mahāmāyāsvarūpaṃ pratipādya ca |
madanāya punaḥ prāha yuktāsau haramohane || 1 ||
1.d:
अथ ब्रह्मा महामायास्वरूपं प्रतिपाद्य च ।
मदनाय पुनः प्राह युक्तासौ हरमोहने ॥ 1 ॥
1.m: Then Brahmā, having explained the true nature of Mahāmāyā, / spoke again to Madana, as she was fit for the deluding of Hara.

1.s: brahmovāca
1.d: ब्रह्मोवाच

1.s:
viṣṇumāyā mahādevo yathā dāraparigraham |
kariṣyati tathā kartumaṅgīkāraṃ purākarot || 2 ||
1.d:
विष्णुमाया महादेवो यथा दारपरिग्रहम् ।
करिष्यति तथा कर्तुमङ्गीकारं पुराकरोत् ॥ 2 ॥
1.m: Viṣṇumāyā previously agreed to act in such a way / that Mahādeva would take a wife.

1.s:
sā'vaśyaṃ dakṣatanayā bhūtvā śambhormahātmanaḥ |
bhaviṣyati dvitīyeti svayamevāvadat smara || 3 ||
1.d:
साऽवश्यं दक्षतनया भूत्वा शम्भोर्महात्मनः ।
भविष्यति द्वितीयेति स्वयमेवावदत् स्मर ॥ 3 ॥
1.m: She herself said, 'O Smara, having become the daughter of Dakṣa, / I will certainly become the partner of the great-souled Śambhu.'

1.s:
tvamebhiḥ svagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ ratyā ca madhunā saha |
yathecchati tathā dārān grahītuṃ kuru śaṃkaraḥ || 4 ||
1.d:
त्वमेभिः स्वगणैः सार्धं रत्या च मधुना सह ।
यथेच्छति तथा दारान् ग्रहीतुं कुरु शंकरः ॥ 4 ॥
1.m: Together with these hosts of yours, and with Rati and Madhu, / act so that Śaṅkara desires to take a wife.

1.s:
śambhau gṛhītadāre tu kṛtakṛtyā vayaṃ smara |
avicchinnā sṛṣṭiriyaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 5 ||
1.d:
शम्भौ गृहीतदारे तु कृतकृत्या वयं स्मर ।
अविच्छिन्ना सृष्टिरियं भविष्यति न संशयः ॥ 5 ॥
1.m: When Śambhu has taken a wife, our purpose will be accomplished, O Smara; / this creation will be unbroken, there is no doubt.

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
tathābravīd dvijaśreṣṭhā lokeśāya manobhavaḥ |
madhuraṃ yat kṛtaṃ tena mahādevasya mohane || 6 ||
1.d:
तथाब्रवीद् द्विजश्रेष्ठा लोकेशाय मनोभवः ।
मधुरं यत् कृतं तेन महादेवस्य मोहने ॥ 6 ॥
1.m: O best of the twice-born, Manobhava then sweetly spoke / to the lord of the world regarding what he had done to delude Mahādeva.

1.s: madana uvāca
1.d: मदन उवाच

1.s:
śṛṇu brahman yathāsmābhiḥ kriyate haramohane |
pratyakṣe vā parokṣe vā tasya tadgadato mama || 7 ||
1.d:
शृणु ब्रह्मन् यथास्माभिः क्रियते हरमोहने ।
प्रत्यक्षे वा परोक्षे वा तस्य तद्गदतो मम ॥ 7 ॥
1.m: Hear, O Brahman, as I tell what has been done by us / in the deluding of Hara, either directly or indirectly before him.

1.s:
yadā samādhimāśritya sthitaḥ śambhurjitendriyaḥ |
tadā sugandhivātena śītalena viveginā |
taṃ vījayāmi lokeśa nityaṃ mohanakāriṇā || 8 ||
1.d:
यदा समाधिमाश्रित्य स्थितः शम्भुर्जितेन्द्रियः ।
तदा सुगन्धिवातेन शीतलेन विवेगिना ।
तं वीजयामि लोकेश नित्यं मोहनकारिणा ॥ 8 ॥
1.m: When Śambhu, having conquered his senses, has entered deep meditation, / then with a fragrant, cool, gentle breeze / that ever causes infatuation, O lord of the world, I fan him.

1.s:
svasāyakāṃstathā pañca samādāya śarāsanam |
bhramāmi tasya savidhe mohayaṃstadgaṇānaham || 9 ||
1.d:
स्वसायकांस्तथा पञ्च समादाय शरासनम् ।
भ्रमामि तस्य सविधे मोहयंस्तद्गणानहम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.m: Taking up my five arrows and my bow, / I roam near him, deluding his attendants.

1.s:
siddhadvandvānahaṃ tatra ramayāmi divāniśam |
bhāvā hāvāśca te sarve praviśanti ca teṣu vai || 10 ||
1.d:
सिद्धद्वन्द्वानहं तत्र रमयामि दिवानिशम् ।
भावा हावाश्च ते सर्वे प्रविशन्ति च तेषु वै ॥ 10 ॥
1.m: There day and night I cause pairs of Siddhas to make love; / all those emotions and gestures of love indeed enter into them.

1.s:
yadi praviṣṭe savidhe śambhoḥ prāṇī pitāmaha |
ko vā na kurute dvandvabhāvaṃ tatra muhurmuhuḥ || 11 ||
1.d:
यदि प्रविष्टे सविधे शम्भोः प्राणी पितामह ।
को वा न कुरुते द्वन्द्वभावं तत्र मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ 11 ॥
1.m: If any creature has entered the presence of Śambhu, O grandfather, / who there does not repeatedly assume the state of a couple?

1.s:
mama praveśamātreṇa tathā syuḥ sarvajantavaḥ |
na śambhurna vṛṣastasya mānasīṃ vikriyāṃ gatau || 12 ||
1.d:
मम प्रवेशमात्रेण तथा स्युः सर्वजन्तवः ।
न शम्भुर्न वृषस्तस्य मानसीं विक्रियां गतौ ॥ 12 ॥
1.m: By my mere entrance, all creatures become so; / yet neither Śambhu nor his bull underwent mental agitation.

1.s:
yadāhi bhavataḥ prasthaṃ sa yāti pramathādhipaḥ |
tatra gantā tadaivāhaṃ saritaḥ samadhurvidhe || 13 ||
1.d:
यदाहि भवतः प्रस्थं स याति प्रमथाधिपः ।
तत्र गन्ता तदैवाहं सरितः समधुर्विधे ॥ 13 ॥
1.m: Whenever the lord of Pramathas goes to your tableland, / I go there immediately, O Vidhi, along with Madhu, [to] the rivers.

1.s:
yadā meruṃ prayātyeṣa yadā vā nāṭakeśvaram |
kailāsaṃ vā yadā yāti tatra gacchāmyahaṃ tadā || 14 ||
1.d:
यदा मेरुं प्रयात्येष यदा वा नाटकेश्वरम् ।
कैलासं वा यदा याति तत्र गच्छाम्यहं तदा ॥ 14 ॥
1.m: When he goes to Meru, or when to Nāṭakeśvara, / or when he goes to Kailāsa, I go there then.

1.s:
yadā tyakta samādhistu harastiṣṭhati vai kṣaṇam |
tatastasya puraścakramithunaṃ yojayāmyaham || 15 ||
1.d:
यदा त्यक्त समाधिस्तु हरस्तिष्ठति वै क्षणम् ।
ततस्तस्य पुरश्चक्रमिथुनं योजयाम्यहम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.m: When Hara abandons his meditation and stays for even a moment, / then before him I unite a pair of cakravāka birds.

1.s:
taccakrayugalaṃ brahman hāvabhāvayutaṃ muhuḥ |
nānābhāvena kurute dāmpatyakramamuttamam || 16 ||
1.d:
तच्चक्रयुगलं ब्रह्मन् हावभावयुतं मुहुः ।
नानाभावेन कुरुते दाम्पत्यक्रममुत्तमम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.m: That pair of birds, O Brahman, repeatedly displaying gestures and emotions of love, / performs the excellent rite of couples through various moods.

1.s:
nīlakaṇṭhānapi muhuḥ sajāyānapi tatpuraḥ |
sammohayāmi savidhe mṛgānanyāṃśca pakṣiṇaḥ || 17 ||
1.d:
नीलकण्ठानपि मुहुः सजायानपि तत्पुरः ।
सम्मोहयामि सविधे मृगानन्यांश्च पक्षिणः ॥ 17 ॥
1.m: Again and again before him I also deeply bewitch / peacocks with their mates, as well as deer and other birds in his presence.

1.s:
vicitrabhāvamāsādya yadā prakurute ratim |
mayūramithunaṃ vīkṣya tattadā ko na cotsukaḥ || 18 ||
1.d:
विचित्रभावमासाद्य यदा प्रकुरुते रतिम् ।
मयूरमिथुनं वीक्ष्य तत्तदा को न चोत्सुकः ॥ 18 ॥
1.m: When, entering into diverse feelings, a pair of peacocks makes love / upon seeing it, who would not then be filled with longing?

1.s:
mṛgāśca tatpurasthāśca svajāyābhistu sotsukāḥ |
akurvan ruciraṃ bhāvaṃ tasya pārśve purastadā || 19 ||
1.d:
मृगाश्च तत्पुरस्थाश्च स्वजायाभिस्तु सोत्सुकाः ।
अकुर्वन् रुचिरं भावं तस्य पार्श्वे पुरस्तदा ॥ 19 ॥
1.m: And the deer standing before him, full of longing with their mates, / displayed charming emotion right beside him in front of him.

1.s:
apaśyan vivaraṃ nāsya kadācidapi maccharaḥ |
nipātyaḥ sa yadā dehe yanmayā sarvalokadhṛt || 20 ||
1.d:
अपश्यन् विवरं नास्य कदाचिदपि मच्छरः ।
निपात्यः स यदा देहे यन्मया सर्वलोकधृत् ॥ 20 ॥
1.m: Yet my arrow, which supports all the worlds, could never find an opening / by which it could be cast into his body.

1.s:
bahudhā niścitaṃ jñātaṃ rāmāsaṃgādṛte haram |
alaṃ ca sammohayituṃ sasahāyo'pi niṣkalam || 21 ||
1.d:
बहुधा निश्चितं ज्ञातं रामासंगादृते हरम् ।
अलं च सम्मोहयितुं ससहायोऽपि निष्कलम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.m: It has been ascertained in many ways: without the company of a woman, / even with allies, I am unable to bewitch the partless Hara.

1.s:
madhuśca kurute karma yadyattasya vimohane |
tacchṛṇuṣva mahābhāga nityaṃ tasyocitaṃ punaḥ || 22 ||
1.d:
मधुश्च कुरुते कर्म यद्यत्तस्य विमोहने ।
तच्छृणुष्व महाभाग नित्यं तस्योचितं पुनः ॥ 22 ॥
1.m: Whatever deed Madhu also does to bewitch him, / hear that again, O highly fortunate one, which is ever suited to him.

1.s:
campakān keśarānāmrān karuṇān pāṭalāṃstathā |
nāgakeśarapunnāgān kiṃśukān ketakān dhavān || 23 ||
1.d:
चम्पकान् केशरानाम्रान् करुणान् पाटलांस्तथा ।
नागकेशरपुन्नागान् किंशुकान् केतकान् धवान् ॥ 23 ॥
1.m: The campaka, keśara, mango, karuṇa, and pāṭalā trees, / the nāgakeśara, punnāga, kiṃśuka, ketaka, and dhava trees—

1.s:
mādhavīrmallikāḥ parṇadhārān kuruvakāṃstathā |
utphullayati tattasya yatra tiṣṭhati vai haraḥ || 24 ||
1.d:
माधवीर्मल्लिकाः पर्णधारान् कुरुवकांस्तथा ।
उत्फुल्लयति तत्तस्य यत्र तिष्ठति वै हरः ॥ 24 ॥
1.m: and the mādhavī, mallikā, parṇadhāra, and kuruvaka blossoms— / he makes them all bloom where Hara stays.

1.s:
sarāṃsyutphullapadmāni bījayan malayānilaiḥ |
sugandhīkṛtavān yatnādatīva śaṃkarāśramam || 25 ||
1.d:
सरांस्युत्फुल्लपद्मानि बीजयन् मलयानिलैः ।
सुगन्धीकृतवान् यत्नादतीव शंकराश्रमम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.m: Fanning with the Malaya breezes the lakes whose lotuses had opened, / he assiduously made Śaṃkara's hermitage exceedingly fragrant.

1.s:
latāḥ sarvāḥ sumanasaḥ phullapādapasaṃcayān |
vṛkṣān rucirabhāvena veṣṭayanti sma tatra vai || 26 ||
1.d:
लताः सर्वाः सुमनसः फुल्लपादपसंचयान् ।
वृक्षान् रुचिरभावेन वेष्टयन्ति स्म तत्र वै ॥ 26 ॥
1.m: All the blossoming creepers there / delightfully entwined the clumps of blossoming trees.

1.s:
tān vṛkṣāṃścārupuṣpaughāṃstaiḥ sugandhisamīraṇaiḥ |
dṛṣṭvā kāmavaśaṃ yāto na tatra munirapyuta || 27 ||
1.d:
तान् वृक्षांश्चारुपुष्पौघांस्तैः सुगन्धिसमीरणैः ।
दृष्ट्वा कामवशं यातो न तत्र मुनिरप्युत ॥ 27 ॥
1.m: Seeing those trees with masses of lovely flowers in those fragrant breezes, / not even a sage there succumbed to desire.

1.s:
tadgaṇā api lokeśa nānābhāvaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ |
vasanti sma surāḥ siddhā ye ye cātitapodhanāḥ || 28 ||
1.d:
तद्गणा अपि लोकेश नानाभावैः सुशोभनैः ।
वसन्ति स्म सुराः सिद्धा ये ये चातितपोधनाः ॥ 28 ॥
1.m: His attendants also, O lord of the world, in various most splendid moods, / lived [there], along with gods, siddhas, and whoever were great ascetics.

1.s:
na tasya punarasmābhirdṛṣṭaṃ mohasya kāraṇam |
bhāvamātraṃ na kurute kāmotthamapi śaṃkaraḥ || 29 ||
1.d:
न तस्य पुनरस्माभिर्दृष्टं मोहस्य कारणम् ।
भावमात्रं न कुरुते कामोत्थमपि शंकरः ॥ 29 ॥
1.m: Yet we saw no cause for his delusion; / Śaṃkara did not produce even the slightest sentiment born of desire.

1.s:
iti sarvamahaṃ dṛṣṭvā jñātvā ca harabhāvanām |
vimukho'haṃ śambhumohānniyataṃ māyayā binā || 30 ||
1.d:
इति सर्वमहं दृष्ट्वा ज्ञात्वा च हरभावनाम् ।
विमुखोऽहं शम्भुमोहान्नियतं मायया बिना ॥ 30 ॥
1.m: Having seen all this and having recognized Hara's disposition, / I have turned away from deluding Śambhu, [for it is] surely [impossible] without Māyā.

1.s:
idānīṃ tvadvacaḥ śrutvā yoganidroditaṃ punaḥ |
tasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ śrutvātha gaṇān dṛṣṭvā sahāyakān || 31 ||
1.d:
इदानीं त्वद्वचः श्रुत्वा योगनिद्रोदितं पुनः ।
तस्याः प्रभावं श्रुत्वाथ गणान् दृष्ट्वा सहायकान् ॥ 31 ॥
1.m: Now, having heard your words spoken concerning Yoganidrā, / having heard of her power, and having seen these attendants as helpers,

1.s:
mayā śambhorvimohāya kriyate muhurudyamaḥ |
bhavānapi trilokeśa yoganidrā drutaṃ punaḥ |
bhaved yathā śambhujāyā tathaiva vidadhātviyam || 32 ||
1.d:
मया शम्भोर्विमोहाय क्रियते मुहुरुद्यमः ।
भवानपि त्रिलोकेश योगनिद्रा द्रुतं पुनः ।
भवेद् यथा शम्भुजाया तथैव विदधात्वियम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.m: I make constant exertion to delude Śambhu. / You too, O lord of the three worlds, arrange it so that / Yoganidrā swiftly becomes Śambhu's wife.

1.s:
yamānāṃ niyamānāñca prāṇāyāmasya nityaśaḥ |
āsanasya maheśasya pratyāhārasya gocare || 33 ||
1.d:
यमानां नियमानाञ्च प्राणायामस्य नित्यशः ।
आसनस्य महेशस्य प्रत्याहारस्य गोचरे ॥ 33 ॥
1.m: Regarding the restraints, observances, and constant breath-control, / the posture, and the sense-withdrawal of the great lord,

1.s:
dhyānasya dhāraṇāyāśca samādhervighnasambhavam |
manye kartuṃ na śakyaṃ syādapi māraśatairapi || 34 ||
1.d:
ध्यानस्य धारणायाश्च समाधेर्विघ्नसम्भवम् ।
मन्ये कर्तुं न शक्यं स्यादपि मारशतैरपि ॥ 34 ॥
1.m: and concerning his meditation, concentration, and absorption, I think an obstacle / cannot be created even by a hundred Mādhavas [or Kāmas].

1.s:
tathāpyayaṃ māragaṇaḥ karotu harasya yogāṅgavikāravighnam |
yadeva śakyaṃ kimu vā samarthaḥ samakṣamanyasya na kartu bhojaḥ || 35 ||
1.d:
तथाप्ययं मारगणः करोतु हरस्य योगाङ्गविकारविघ्नम् ।
यदेव शक्यं किमु वा समर्थः समक्षमन्यस्य न कर्तु भोजः ॥ 35 ॥
1.m: Nevertheless, let this troop of Kāma bring about an obstacle and disturbance to Hara's limbs of yoga, / whatever is possible; or is a capable one not to act in the presence of another?

1.s:
iti śrīkālikāpurāṇe vadanavākye saptato'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
1.d:
इति श्रीकालिकापुराणे वदनवाक्ये सप्ततोऽध्यायः ॥ 7 ॥
अष्टमोऽध्यायः
1.m: Thus ends the seventh chapter, the speech of Vadana, in the glorious Kālikāpurāṇa. / The eighth chapter.

1.s: mārkaṇṇdeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्ण्देय उवाच

1.s:
tato brahmāpi madanamuvācedaṃ vacaḥ punaḥ |
niścitya yoganidrāyāḥ smṛtvā vākyaṃ tapodhanāḥ || 1 ||
1.d:
ततो ब्रह्मापि मदनमुवाचेदं वचः पुनः ।
निश्चित्य योगनिद्रायाः स्मृत्वा वाक्यं तपोधनाः ॥ 1 ॥
1.m: Then Brahmā also spoke these words again to Madana, / having made his resolve and remembering the word of Yoganidrā, O ascetics:

1.s: brahmovāca
1.d: ब्रह्मोवाच

1.s:
avaśyaṃ śambhupatnī sā yoganidrā bhaviṣyati |
yathāśakti bhavāṃstatra karotvasyāḥ sahāyatām || 2 ||
1.d:
अवश्यं शम्भुपत्नी सा योगनिद्रा भविष्यति ।
यथाशक्ति भवांस्तत्र करोत्वस्याः सहायताम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.m: She, Yoganidrā, shall certainly become Śambhu's wife; / you must assist her there according to your ability.

1.s:
gaccha tvaṃ svagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ yatra tiṣṭhati śaṃkaraḥ |
drutaṃ manobhava tvaṃ ca tat sthānaṃ madhunā saha || 6 ||
1.d:
गच्छ त्वं स्वगणैः सार्द्धं यत्र तिष्ठति शंकरः ।
द्रुतं मनोभव त्वं च तत् स्थानं मधुना सह ॥ 6 ॥
1.m: Go with your attendants to where Śaṃkara stays; / swiftly go, O mind-born one, to that place together with Madhu.

1.s:
rātrindivasya turyāṃśaṃ jaganmohaya nityaśaḥ |
bhāgatrayaṃ śambhupārśve tiṣṭha sārddhaṃ gaṇaiḥ sadā || 4 ||
1.d:
रात्रिन्दिवस्य तुर्यांशं जगन्मोहय नित्यशः ।
भागत्रयं शम्भुपार्श्वे तिष्ठ सार्द्धं गणैः सदा ॥ 4 ॥
1.m: Delude the world for one-fourth of the day and night at all times; / for three parts, stay constantly beside Śambhu with your attendants.

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
ityuktvā sarvalokeśastatraivāntaradhīyata |
śambhoḥ sakāśaṃ madano gatavān sagaṇastadā || 5 ||
1.d:
इत्युक्त्वा सर्वलोकेशस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।
शम्भोः सकाशं मदनो गतवान् सगणस्तदा ॥ 5 ॥
1.m: Having spoken thus, the lord of all the worlds vanished right there. / Madana then went into Śambhu's presence along with his attendants.

1.s:
etasminnantare dakṣaściraṃ kālaṃ taporataḥ |
niyamairbahubhirdevīmārādhayata suvrataḥ || 6 ||
1.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दक्षश्चिरं कालं तपोरतः ।
नियमैर्बहुभिर्देवीमाराधयत सुव्रतः ॥ 6 ॥
1.m: Meanwhile Dakṣa, devoted to austerities for a long time, / worshipped the goddess with many observances, being of good vows.

1.s:
tato niyamayuktasya dakṣasya munisattamaḥ |
yoganidrāṃ pūjayataḥ pratyakṣamabhavacchivā || 7 ||
1.d:
ततो नियमयुक्तस्य दक्षस्य मुनिसत्तमः ।
योगनिद्रां पूजयतः प्रत्यक्षमभवच्छिवा ॥ 7 ॥
1.m: Then, O best of sages, to Dakṣa, engaged in observances / and worshipping Yoganidrā, the auspicious goddess became visible before his eyes.

1.s:
tataḥ pratyakṣato dṛṣṭvā viṣṇumāyāṃ jaganmayīm |
kṛtakṛtyamathātmānaṃ mene dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 8 ||
1.d:
ततः प्रत्यक्षतो दृष्ट्वा विष्णुमायां जगन्मयीम् ।
कृतकृत्यमथात्मानं मेने दक्षः प्रजापतिः ॥ 8 ॥
1.m: Then, seeing before his eyes the Viṣṇumāyā who comprises the universe, / Prajāpati Dakṣa considered himself to have achieved his purpose:

1.s:
siṃhasthāṃ kālikāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ pīnottuṅgapayodharām |
caturbhujāṃ cāruvaktrāṃ nīlotpaladharāṃ śubhām || 9 ||
1.d:
सिंहस्थां कालिकां कृष्णां पीनोत्तुङ्गपयोधराम् ।
चतुर्भुजां चारुवक्त्रां नीलोत्पलधरां शुभाम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.m: mounted on a lion, black as Kālī, with full, elevated breasts, / four-armed, fair-faced, holding a blue lotus, auspicious,

1.s:
varadābhayadāṃ khaḍgahastāṃ sarvaguṇānvitām |
āraktanayanāṃ cārumuktakeśī manoharām || 10 ||
1.d:
वरदाभयदां खड्गहस्तां सर्वगुणान्विताम् ।
आरक्तनयनां चारुमुक्तकेशी मनोहराम् ॥ 10 ॥
1.m: granting boons and fearlessness, holding a sword in her hand, endowed with all virtuous qualities, / with reddish eyes, lovely, with disheveled hair, captivating.

1.s:
dṛṣṭvā dakṣo'tha tuṣṭāva mahāmāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ |
prītyā paramayā yukto vinayānatakandharaḥ || 11 ||
1.d:
दृष्ट्वा दक्षोऽथ तुष्टाव महामायां प्रजापतिः ।
प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो विनयानतकन्धरः ॥ 11 ॥
1.m: Seeing her, Prajāpati Dakṣa then praised Mahāmāyā, / filled with supreme affection, his neck bowed in humility.

1.s: dakṣa uvāca
1.d: दक्ष उवाच

1.s:
ānandarūpiṇīṃ devīṃ jagadānandakāriṇīm |
sṛṣṭisthityantarūpāṃ tāṃ staumi lakṣmīṃ hareḥ śubhām || 12 ||
1.d:
आनन्दरूपिणीं देवीं जगदानन्दकारिणीम् ।
सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तरूपां तां स्तौमि लक्ष्मीं हरेः शुभाम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.m: I praise that auspicious Lakṣmī of Hari, who consists of bliss, / who causes bliss to the universe, whose form is the creation, preservation, and end [of the world].

1.s:
sattvodrekaprakāśena yajjyotistattvamuttamam |
svaprakāśaṃ jagaddhāma tattavāṃśaṃ maheśvari || 13 ||
1.d:
सत्त्वोद्रेकप्रकाशेन यज्ज्योतिस्तत्त्वमुत्तमम् ।
स्वप्रकाशं जगद्धाम तत्तवांशं महेश्वरि ॥ 13 ॥
1.m: That supreme essence of light which arises through the excess of sattva, / self-luminous, the resting place of the universe—that is a part of you, O great goddess.

1.s:
rajoguṇātirekeṇa yat kāmasya prakāśanam |
rāgasvarūpaṃ madhyasthaṃ tatteṃ'śāṃśaṃ jaganmayi || 14 ||
1.d:
रजोगुणातिरेकेण यत् कामस्य प्रकाशनम् ।
रागस्वरूपं मध्यस्थं तत्तेंऽशांशं जगन्मयि ॥ 14 ॥
1.m: That manifestation of desire through the excess of the quality of rajas, / which is of the nature of passion, situated in the middle—that is a particle of your part, O you who comprise the universe.

1.s:
tamoguṇātirekeṇa yadyanmohaprakāśanam |
ācchādanaṃ cetanānāṃ tatte cāṃśāṃśagocaram || 15 ||
1.d:
तमोगुणातिरेकेण यद्यन्मोहप्रकाशनम् ।
आच्छादनं चेतनानां तत्ते चांशांशगोचरम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.m: That manifestation of delusion through the excess of the quality of tamas, / which is the covering of conscious beings—that also falls within a particle of your part.

1.s:
parā parātmikā śuddhā nirmalā lokamohinī |
tvaṃ trirūpā trayī kīrtirvārttāsya jagato gatiḥ || 16 ||
1.d:
परा परात्मिका शुद्धा निर्मला लोकमोहिनी ।
त्वं त्रिरूपा त्रयी कीर्तिर्वार्त्तास्य जगतो गतिः ॥ 16 ॥
1.m: Supreme, consisting of the highest, pure, spotless, deluder of the worlds, / you are the three-formed, the triple Veda, renown, livelihood, the refuge of this universe.

1.s:
bibharti mādhavo dhātrīṃ yathā mūrttyā nijotthayā |
sā mūrttistava sarveṣāṃ jagatāmupakāriṇī || 17 ||
1.d:
बिभर्ति माधवो धात्रीं यथा मूर्त्त्या निजोत्थया ।
सा मूर्त्तिस्तव सर्वेषां जगतामुपकारिणी ॥ 17 ॥
1.m: Just as Mādhava supports the earth with a form arisen from himself, / that form of yours is a benefactor to all the worlds.

1.s:
mahānubhāvā tvaṃ viśvaśaktiḥ sūkṣmāparājitā |
yadūrdhvādhonirodhena vyajyate pavanaiḥ param || 18 ||
1.d:
महानुभावा त्वं विश्वशक्तिः सूक्ष्मापराजिता ।
यदूर्ध्वाधोनिरोधेन व्यज्यते पवनैः परम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.m: You are of great majesty, the power of the universe, subtle, unconquered; / the supreme [light] which is revealed by the breaths through blocking above and below,

1.s:
tajjyotistava mātrārthe sāttvikaṃ bhāvasammatam |
yadyogino nirālambaṃ niṣphalaṃ nirmalaṃ param || 19 ||
1.d:
तज्ज्योतिस्तव मात्रार्थे सात्त्विकं भावसम्मतम् ।
यद्योगिनो निरालम्बं निष्फलं निर्मलं परम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.m: that light of yours, approved in its nature, is sāttvika for the sake of the [sacred] syllables; / which the yogins, [focusing on it as] supportless, without fruit, spotless, supreme,

1.s:
ālambayanti tattattvaṃ tvadantargocarantu tat |
yā prasiddhā ca kūṭasthā suprasiddhātinirmalā || 20 ||
1.d:
आलम्बयन्ति तत्तत्त्वं त्वदन्तर्गोचरन्तु तत् ।
या प्रसिद्धा च कूटस्था सुप्रसिद्धातिनिर्मला ॥ 20 ॥
1.m: take as their support—that reality is indeed within your scope. / She who is famous, unchanging, renowned, and exceedingly pure,

1.s:
sā jñaptistvanniṣprapañcā prapañcāpi prakāśikā |
tvaṃ vidyā tvamavidyā ca tvamālambā nirāśrayā |
prapañcarūpā jagatāmādiśaktistvamīśvarī || 21 ||
1.d:
सा ज्ञप्तिस्त्वन्निष्प्रपञ्चा प्रपञ्चापि प्रकाशिका ।
त्वं विद्या त्वमविद्या च त्वमालम्बा निराश्रया ।
प्रपञ्चरूपा जगतामादिशक्तिस्त्वमीश्वरी ॥ 21 ॥
1.m: she is consciousness, beyond phenomenal world, yet illuminating the phenomenal world; / you are knowledge and you are ignorance; you are the support, yet without foundation; / having the form of the phenomenal world, you are the primordial power of the universe, the sovereign goddess.

1.s:
brahmakaṇṭhālayā śuddhā vāgvāṇī yā pragīyate |
vedaprakāśanaparā sā tvaṃ viśvaprakāśinī || 22 ||
1.d:
ब्रह्मकण्ठालया शुद्धा वाग्वाणी या प्रगीयते ।
वेदप्रकाशनपरा सा त्वं विश्वप्रकाशिनी ॥ 22 ॥
1.m: The pure speech and utterance that is sung as residing in Brahmā's throat, / devoted to illuminating the Vedas—that are you, the illuminator of the universe.

1.s:
tvamagnistvaṃ tathā svāhā tvaṃ svadhā pitṛbhiḥ saha |
tvaṃ nabhastvaṃ kālarūpā tvaṃ kāṣṭhā tvaṃ bahiḥsthitā || 26 ||
1.d:
त्वमग्निस्त्वं तथा स्वाहा त्वं स्वधा पितृभिः सह ।
त्वं नभस्त्वं कालरूपा त्वं काष्ठा त्वं बहिःस्थिता ॥ 26 ॥
1.m: You are Agni, and you are Svāhā; you are Svadhā together with the ancestors; / you are the sky, you are of the form of time, you are the measure of time, you are situated outside.

1.s:
tvamacintyā tvamavyaktā tathānirdeśyarūpiṇī |
tvaṃ kālarātristvaṃ śāntā tvameva prakṛtiḥ parā || 24 ||
1.d:
त्वमचिन्त्या त्वमव्यक्ता तथानिर्देश्यरूपिणी ।
त्वं कालरात्रिस्त्वं शान्ता त्वमेव प्रकृतिः परा ॥ 24 ॥
1.m: You are unthinkable, unmanifest, and likewise of undefinable form; / you are the night of time, you are peaceful, you alone are the supreme Prakṛti.

1.s:
yasyāḥ saṃsāralokānāṃ paritrāṇāya yadbahiḥ |
rūpaṃ jānanti dhātrādyāstattvāṃ jñāsyanti ke parām || 25 ||
1.d:
यस्याः संसारलोकानां परित्राणाय यद्बहिः ।
रूपं जानन्ति धात्राद्यास्तत्त्वां ज्ञास्यन्ति के पराम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.m: When Brahmā and the others know only that external form / which belongs to her for the protection of the beings of the worldly cycle, who can know you, the supreme one?

1.s:
prasīda bhagavatyamba prasīda yogarūpiṇi |
prasīda ghorarūpe tvaṃ jaganmayi namo'stu te || 26 ||
1.d:
प्रसीद भगवत्यम्ब प्रसीद योगरूपिणि ।
प्रसीद घोररूपे त्वं जगन्मयि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 26 ॥
1.m: Be pleased, O goddess, mother; be pleased, O you whose form is yoga; / be pleased, O you of terrible form, comprising the universe; homage to you!

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
iti stutā mahāmāyā dakṣeṇa prayatātmanā |
uvāca dakṣaṃ jñātvāpi svayaṃ tasyepsitaṃ dvijāḥ || 27 ||
1.d:
इति स्तुता महामाया दक्षेण प्रयतात्मना ।
उवाच दक्षं ज्ञात्वापि स्वयं तस्येप्सितं द्विजाः ॥ 27 ॥
1.m: Thus praised by Dakṣa with a restrained mind, / Mahāmāyā spoke to Dakṣa, O twice-born ones, though knowing his desire herself:

1.s: bhagavatyuvāca
1.d: भगवत्युवाच

1.s:
tuṣṭāhaṃ dakṣa bhavato madbhaktyā hyanayā bhṛśam |
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva cābhīṣṭaṃ tatte dāsyāmi tata svayam || 28 ||
1.d:
तुष्टाहं दक्ष भवतो मद्भक्त्या ह्यनया भृशम् ।
वरं वृणीष्व चाभीष्टं तत्ते दास्यामि तत स्वयम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.m: I am greatly pleased with you, O Dakṣa, by this devotion to me; / choose a desired boon, and I will give it to you myself, my child.

1.s:
niyamena tapobhiśca stutibhiste prajāpate |
atīva tuṣṭā dāsye'haṃ varaṃ varaya vāñchitam || 29||
1.d:
नियमेन तपोभिश्च स्तुतिभिस्ते प्रजापते ।
अतीव तुष्टा दास्येऽहं वरं वरय वाञ्छितम् ॥ 29॥
1.m: By your observance, your austerities, and your praises, O Prajāpati, / I am exceedingly pleased; I will grant it: choose the boon you desire.

1.s: dakṣa uvāca
1.d: दक्ष उवाच

1.s:
jaganmayi mahāmāye yadi tvaṃ varadā mama |
tadā mama sutā bhūtvā harajāyā bhavādhunā || 30 ||
1.d:
जगन्मयि महामाये यदि त्वं वरदा मम ।
तदा मम सुता भूत्वा हरजाया भवाधुना ॥ 30 ॥
1.m: O you who comprise the universe, O Mahāmāyā, if you grant me a boon, / then become my daughter now and become Hara's wife.

1.s:
mamaiṣa na varo devi kevalaṃ jagatāmapi |
lokeśasya tathā viṣṇoḥ śivasyāpi prajeśvari || 31 ||
1.d:
ममैष न वरो देवि केवलं जगतामपि ।
लोकेशस्य तथा विष्णोः शिवस्यापि प्रजेश्वरि ॥ 31 ॥
1.m: This boon is not for me alone, O goddess, but for all worlds, / and likewise for the lord of the world, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, O ruler of creatures.

1.s: devyuvāca
1.d: देव्युवाच

1.s:
ahaṃ tava sutā bhūtvā tvajjāyāyāṃ samudbhavā |
harajāyā bhaviṣyāmi na cirāttu prajāpate || 32 ||
1.d:
अहं तव सुता भूत्वा त्वज्जायायां समुद्भवा ।
हरजाया भविष्यामि न चिरात्तु प्रजापते ॥ 32 ॥
1.m: Having become your daughter, born from your wife, / I will become the wife of Hara before long, O Prajāpati.

1.s:
yadā bhavānmayi punarbhavenmandādarastadā |
dehaṃ tyakṣyāmi sapadi sukhinyapyatha vetarā || 33 ||
1.d:
यदा भवान्मयि पुनर्भवेन्मन्दादरस्तदा ।
देहं त्यक्ष्यामि सपदि सुखिन्यप्यथ वेतरा ॥ 33 ॥
1.m: Whenever you, however, become lacking in respect toward me, / then I will cast off my body instantly, whether happy or otherwise.

1.s:
eṣa dattastava varaḥ pratisarga prajāpate |
ahaṃ tava sutā bhūtvā bhaviṣyāmi harapriyā || 34 ||
1.d:
एष दत्तस्तव वरः प्रतिसर्ग प्रजापते ।
अहं तव सुता भूत्वा भविष्यामि हरप्रिया ॥ 34 ॥
1.m: This boon is given to you in every creation, O Prajāpati: / having become your daughter, I shall become the beloved of Hara.

1.s:
tathā sammohayiṣyāmi mahādevaṃ prajāpate |
pratisargaṃ yathā mohaṃ samprāpsyati nirākulam || 35 ||
1.d:
तथा सम्मोहयिष्यामि महादेवं प्रजापते ।
प्रतिसर्गं यथा मोहं सम्प्राप्स्यति निराकुलम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.m: I will so thoroughly bewilder Mahādeva, O Prajāpati, / in every creation, that he will attain undisturbed delusion.

1.s: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
1.d: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

1.s:
evamuktvā mahāmāyā dakṣaṃ mukhyaṃ prajāpatim |
antardadhe tato devī samyag dakṣasya paśyataḥ || 36 ||
1.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महामाया दक्षं मुख्यं प्रजापतिम् ।
अन्तर्दधे ततो देवी सम्यग् दक्षस्य पश्यतः ॥ 36 ॥
1.m: Having spoken thus to Dakṣa, the foremost Prajāpati, / the goddess Mahāmāyā then disappeared completely while Dakṣa looked on.

1.s:
antarhitāyāṃ māyāyāṃ dakṣo'pi nijamāśramam |
jagāma lebhe ca mudaṃ bhaviṣyati suteti sā || 37 ||
1.d:
अन्तर्हितायां मायायां दक्षोऽपि निजमाश्रमम् ।
जगाम लेभे च मुदं भविष्यति सुतेति सा ॥ 37 ॥
1.m: When Māyā had vanished, Dakṣa too went to his own hermitage, / and attained joy, [knowing] that she would become his daughter.

1.s:
atha cakre prajotpādaṃ vinā strīsaṃgamena ca |
saṃkalpāvirbhavābhyāntu manasā cintanena ca || 38 ||
1.d:
अथ चक्रे प्रजोत्पादं विना स्त्रीसंगमेन च ।
संकल्पाविर्भवाभ्यान्तु मनसा चिन्तनेन च ॥ 38 ॥
1.m: Then he undertook the procreation of offspring without union with a woman, / but through the manifestation of mental resolve and through contemplation in his mind.

1.s:
tatra ye tanayā jātā bahuśo dvijasattamāḥ |
te nāradopadeśena bhramanti pṛthivīmimām || 39 ||
1.d:
तत्र ये तनया जाता बहुशो द्विजसत्तमाः ।
ते नारदोपदेशेन भ्रमन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम् ॥ 39 ॥
1.m: The sons who were born there in great numbers, O best of the twice-born, / wander over this earth at the instruction of Nārada.

1.s:
punaḥ punaḥ sutā ye ye tasya jātā sahasraśaḥ |
te sarve bhrātṛpadavīṃ yayurnāradavākyataḥ || 40 ||
1.d:
पुनः पुनः सुता ये ये तस्य जाता सहस्रशः ।
ते सर्वे भ्रातृपदवीं ययुर्नारदवाक्यतः ॥ 40 ॥
1.m: Again and again, whatever sons were born to him by the thousands, / they all followed the path of their brothers on the word of Nārada.

1.s:
pṛthivyāṃ sṛṣṭikartāraḥ sarve yūyaṃ dvijottamāḥ |
paśyadhvaṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāmupāntaprāntamāyatām || 41 ||
1.d:
पृथिव्यां सृष्टिकर्तारः सर्वे यूयं द्विजोत्तमाः ।
पश्यध्वं पृथिवीं कृत्स्नामुपान्तप्रान्तमायताम् ॥ 41 ॥
1.m: "You are all the makers of creation upon the earth, O best of the twice-born; / behold the entire earth, vast from border to border!"

1.s:
iti nāradavākyena noditā dakṣaputrakāḥ |
adyāpi na nivartante bhramantaḥ pṛthivīmimām || 42 ||
1.d:
इति नारदवाक्येन नोदिता दक्षपुत्रकाः ।
अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते भ्रमन्तः पृथिवीमिमाम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.m: Urged on by these words of Nārada, Dakṣa's sons / even today do not return, wandering over this earth.

1.s:
tataḥ samutpādayituṃ prajāḥ maithunasambhavāḥ |
upayeme vīraṇasya tanayāṃ dakṣa īpsitām || 43 ||
1.d:
ततः समुत्पादयितुं प्रजाः मैथुनसम्भवाः ।
उपयेमे वीरणस्य तनयां दक्ष ईप्सिताम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.m: Then, in order to generate offspring born from sexual union, / Dakṣa married the desirable daughter of Vīraṇa.

1.s:
vīriṇī nāma tasyāstu asaknītyapi sattamāḥ |
tasyāṃ prathamasaṃkalpo yadā bhūtaḥ prajāpate || 44 ||
1.d:
वीरिणी नाम तस्यास्तु असक्नीत्यपि सत्तमाः ।
तस्यां प्रथमसंकल्पो यदा भूतः प्रजापते ॥ 44 ॥
1.m: Her name was Vīriṇī, and also Asiknī, O best of men; / when the first resolve [for procreation] took place in her by the Prajāpati,

1.s:
sadyojātā mahāmāyā tadā tasyāṃ dvijottamāḥ |
tasyāṃ tu jātamātrāyāṃ suprīto'bhūt prajāpatiḥ |
saivaiṣeti tadā mene tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tejasojjvalām || 45 ||
1.d:
सद्योजाता महामाया तदा तस्यां द्विजोत्तमाः ।
तस्यां तु जातमात्रायां सुप्रीतोऽभूत् प्रजापतिः ।
सैवैषेति तदा मेने तां दृष्ट्वा तेजसोज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 45 ॥
1.m: then Mahāmāyā was immediately born in her, O best of the twice-born. / As soon as she was born to her, the Prajāpati was overjoyed; / seeing her radiant with splendor, he thought then: "This is indeed she."

1.s:
babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca meghāśca vavṛṣurjalam |
diśaḥ śāntāstadā tasyāṃ jātāyāñca samudgatāḥ || 46 ||
1.d:
बभूव पुष्पवृष्टिश्च मेघाश्च ववृषुर्जलम् ।
दिशः शान्तास्तदा तस्यां जातायाञ्च समुद्गताः ॥ 46 ॥
1.m: There was a shower of flowers, and the clouds rained water; / the directions were peaceful then, appearing serene when she was born.

1.s:
avādayantastridaśāḥ śubhavādyaṃ viyadgatāḥ |
jajvaluścāgnayaḥ śāntāstasyāṃ satyāṃ narottamāḥ || 47 ||
1.d:
अवादयन्तस्त्रिदशाः शुभवाद्यं वियद्गताः ।
जज्वलुश्चाग्नयः शान्तास्तस्यां सत्यां नरोत्तमाः ॥ 47 ॥
1.m: The gods, stationed in the sky, played auspicious instruments, / and the pacified fires flared up, O best of men, when she, Satī, [was born].

1.s:
vīriṇyā lakṣito dakṣastāṃ dṛṣṭvā jagadīśvarīm |
viṣṇumāyāṃ mahāmāyāṃ toṣayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 48 ||
1.d:
वीरिण्या लक्षितो दक्षस्तां दृष्ट्वा जगदीश्वरीम् ।
विष्णुमायां महामायां तोषयामास भक्तितः ॥ 48 ॥
1.m: Dakṣa, accompanied by Vīriṇī, upon seeing the ruler of the universe, / Viṣṇumāyā, Mahāmāyā, propitiated her with devotion.

1.s: dakṣa uvāca
1.d: दक्ष उवाच

1.s:
śivā śāntā mahāmāyā yoganidrā jaganmayī |
yā procyate viṣṇumāyā tāṃ namāmi sanātanīm || 49 ||
1.d:
शिवा शान्ता महामाया योगनिद्रा जगन्मयी ।
या प्रोच्यते विष्णुमाया तां नमामि सनातनीम् ॥ 49 ॥
1.m: Auspicious, peaceful, Mahāmāyā, Yoganidrā, comprising the universe, / who is proclaimed as Viṣṇumāyā—to her, the eternal one, I bow.

1.s:
yayā dhātā jagatsṛṣṭau niyuktastāṃ purākarot |
sthitiñca viṣṇurakarodyanniyogājjagatpatiḥ || 50 ||
